- Use our free Bill Pay service to pay any bill 
- Send and request money using our Pay a Friend service
- Make one-time or scheduled transfers between your Canopy accounts

- Find the nearest branches and ATMs
- Speak with a live representative using our convenient ‘Chat Now’ feature
- Send secure messages to get your questions answered
Take charge of your money with our new Money Management tool:
- Link your external accounts at other financial institutions to get a holistic picture of your finances
- Set up your budget by analyzing your current income and spending
- Establish financial goals
- Track your net worth over time
- Create a cash flow calendar
Canopy Credit Union, Federally insured by NCUA.

bluejetty:00092888:ios.name: WB Artesia-Mobile
bluejetty:00092888:ios.summary: WB Artesia-Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier
bluejetty:00092888:ios.description:
WB Artesia-Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with WB Artesia-Mobile:
 - Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 - Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 - Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 - Transfer money between your accounts
 - Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 - Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 - View and save your monthly statements
 - Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the WB Artesia-Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Western Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00064142:ios.description:
Video Call Santa! Voice Call Santa! Message Santa! Track Santa! The only Santa Video Call app with varied and customizable conversation options! Santa actually knows all about you (12 facts including your name)! On Christmas Eve you can even talk to Santa while he's on his sleigh!
Welcome to North Pole Command Center! Here at the North Pole Science Department, our Engineers are always looking for ways to modernise Christmas, their latest creation is this hi-tech Santa Tracking/ Santa Calling App!
VIDEO CALL SANTA - For the first time ever, you can now Video Call Santa! This is not a simple video recording of Santa, this is a dynamic, varied, and realistic simulated call. Santa knows your name, he knows things like your favourite colour, your favourite sport and tons more. He also knows when you've been naughty or nice, and he's not afraid to bring it up during the call! The call can even be recorded to kept forever or shared!
• Santa's List knows the following things about your kids:
- Their Name
- Their Age
- Their Month of Birth
- Where They Live
- Their Favourite Colour
- Their Favourite Fruit
- Their Favourite Vegetable
- Their Favourite Sport
- If they've been learning a musical Instrument
- Recent Life Events
- Gift Wanted
• Theres so many call options. Here are a few:
- Santa know what gift your kid wants!
- Child has been Naughty: Santa even says what they've done thats naughty!
- Child has been Nice: Santa knows when you've been nice!
- Tips for getting on the nice list
- Santa checks his list to see if they are on the nice of naughty list!
- And so many more
TRACK SANTA - Using the very latest is Elfish satellite technology, this app can pinpoint Santa's location anywhere on the planet to within an Elfish Micrometer (which is a lot smaller than a regular micrometer!)
The app also allows you to run test flights with Santa's sleigh in the lead-up to the big day. Then when the big day arrives it accurately tracks Santa's journey across the globe!
• Fully 3D Globe that you can rotate and zoom in or out on!
• Sleigh data such as km/h and percentage of presents delivered sent dynamically to the app as Santa makes his journey!
• Send Santa on test runs where you can control the speed of his sleigh!
• Countdown timer to the big day!
• Reindeer data! See what Rudolph and the gang are up to!
CALL SANTA - Talk to Santa! Give him a call or have him call you! On Christmas Eve you can even talk to Santa while he's on his sleigh! *Parents can use the Santa Call functionality to keep children well behaved! REQUIRES PARENTAL SETUP*
• High-quality voices!
• Over 7000 child names! PLEASE VISIT OUR WEBSITE FOR FULL LIST OF INCLUDED NAMES - http://tillmania.co.uk/santa-call-name-list/
• Thousands of possible call setups!
SANTA BOOTH - Add pictures of Santa to your images as proof that Santa visited on Christmas Eve!
MESSAGE SANTA - Send Santa messages! Receive messages from Santa! *Parents can use the Message Santa functionality to keep children well behaved! REQUIRES PARENTAL SETUP*
SOCIAL - The latest craze sweeping the North Pole. This is THE social networking site for Elves and Reindeer! 
SANTA’S BLOG - Santa’s blog is currently in its fourth year! All years are included so if you’re new to the party you’ve got plenty to catch up on!
SANTA’S LIST - Santa's Naughty/Nice List has finally gone digital! Check out where you are on THE LIST!
NORTH POLE NEWS - Brand new Digital News Feed straight from the North Pole! Now in its fourth year!
BEARDIFIER - Want a beard like Santa's but haven't got the time to grow one? WORRY NOT! The Beardifier adds a beard automatically to anyone you take a photo of!
PHOTO BOOTH - Add ears and hats to your pics!
Basically, this is THE Christmas app for you! 
Terms & Conditions: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/7948436

bluejetty:00013875:ios.description:
Install Bluecrew and join our team of more than 900,000 Crew Members who have worked over 1 million shifts!
Bluecrew is more than just a job app. Our technology puts you in control by matching you with short and long-term, part-time and full-time hourly job assignments and letting you choose the ones that fit your life. Plus, when you work for Bluecrew, you are a W-2 employee, protected with benefits like overtime, sick days, and workers' comp. 
How do I join Bluecrew?
- Download the Bluecrew app and sign up
- Choose a job that fits your preferences, skills and schedule
- Complete a one-time onboarding to become an eligible worker - we call our workers Crew Members!
- Work and get paid weekly. And get paid early with On-Demand Pay, which allows you to access your weekly earnings days before payday
Why work with Bluecrew?
*Choose Work in Real-Time
Browse our network of diverse job assignments - including work in warehouses, retail, food service, stadiums, events, and more - then choose a shift schedule and get confirmed immediately.
*Set Your Own Schedule
Job assignments come straight to your phone, complete with wage, location, job description and more. Select the work you want and build your own schedule - all in the app.
*Get W-2 Status Immediately
When you work with Bluecrew, you are a W-2 employee of Bluecrew. Unlike typical “gig work” apps where you are a contractor, Bluecrew offers all of the protections and benefits that come with being W-2, like overtime, sick days, workers' comp and access to insurance.
What are you waiting for? Become a Bluecrew Crew Member to start working and earning!
To learn more about the Bluecrew team, our mission, and what we're up to, visit https://www.bluecrewjobs.com.
Have more questions? Please email us at support@bluecrewjobs.com.

bluejetty:00094834:ios.summary:
Available exclusively for Crunchyroll Mega and Ultimate Fan Members.
Welcome to Coal Town, a lively and prosperous town that seems to have been frozen in time since the Showa era. In this town, there are energetic working-class people goin
bluejetty:00094834:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Crunchyroll Mega and Ultimate Fan Members.
Welcome to Coal Town, a lively and prosperous town that seems to have been frozen in time since the Showa era. In this town, there are energetic working-class people going about their day. After meeting a mysterious young girl, Shinnosuke becomes friends with these people.
And so begins Shinnosuke’s newest adventure…!
FEATURES
- Fish Akita’s diverse rivers to catch common and rare species to add to your nature book collection. 
- Find all kinds of bugs living in the groves and forest of Akita for your nature book collection. 
- Learn to grow vegetables with your grandma, that you can then use in dishes. 
- Create amazing inventions with a gorgeous young lady inventor in Coal Town!
- Help the owner of the Coal Town diner by coming up with new menu items to serve up to eager customers. 
- Join the Trolley Race! Explore unique tracks, choose from a variety of trolleys, and upgrade your trolley with custom parts. 
STORY
The Nohara family is headed to Akita Prefecture!
Hiroshi is suddenly given a job assignment near his hometown in Akita. So the Nohara family make their way to a small village near Hiroshi’s parents’ home and rent out a traditional Japanese farmhouse. Nestled in this tranquil rural landscape, they begin their carefree and quiet life in the countryside.
Ginnosuke, Shinnosuke’s grandfather, bestows the mysteries of country playtime by teaching Shinnosuke how to catch bugs and fish. A highlight of every evening is when the family gathers around the sunken hearth to savor delicious Akita dishes.
In the village, Shinnosuke talks with farmers and makes new friends. Every day, he’s enjoying life to the fullest until…
One morning, Shiro shows up at the house covered in soot. As a confused Shinnosuke looks on, Shiro suddenly dashes away…!
Shinnosuke chases after Shiro until, stopped before him, he notices a mysterious train he’s never seen before. Shinnosuke follows after Shiro and accidentally boards this train leading him to Coal Town. 
____________

bluejetty:00126263:ios.description:
*Over 1.5 million downloads*

Organize your to do list, task list, and reminders with StickMe Notes - the most awesome sticky note & task manager app with built in alarm for iPhone. Use StickMe Notes to upgrade the boring old paper note with HANDWRITTEN or TEXT or notes on your iPhone. If you are too tired to draw or type, you can simply ATTACH A PHOTO or RECORD YOUR AUDIO NOTES.
You can stick these notes with attachments such as text, drawing, record/audio or photo notes to your personalized notice board, set them as your lock screen image or share with friends using email or whatsapp. Use StickMe Note as your notebook & create grocery and shopping lists on the go.
StickMe Notes is a notepad & memo app which makes note taking easy. Use memo notes to capture ideas on the fly, create to-do lists & tasks list, checklist & set up personal daily reminders. It’s a digital note pad that helps you get things done.
Download the best notes maker app now & become notefuly efficient. Keep google urls or pages in sticky notes & revisit them later.
MAKE QUICK NOTES
*Create unlimited sticky notes in any color. Use the note color to organize the stickies better.
*Use the app as task manager & create a todo check list, shopping lists or grocery lists.
*Write in digital ink with your finger. Create quick daily notes or a memo.
*Record voice notes. StickMe Notes can be your audio note pad.
*Take a photo or choose one from your camera roll to create a photo note. Make StickMe Notes your picture notebook.
*Google things & keep important links in sticky notes to revisit later.
WIDGET, SPOTLIGHT & SIRI (For iOS 15 and above)
*Instantly create notes to access your sticky notes on your home screen and lock screen (iPhone only) using widgets.
ORGANIZE
*Drag & move a note to any custom folder.
*Mark notes as ‘Important’.
*Use ‘Secret’ folder for to hide your daily personal notes.
*Make good notes & keep in Folders.
SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
*Access notes on your iPhone, iPad & Mac
SET REMINDERS & USE AS WALLPAPER
*Set alarm for your notes & stickies to remind you about your check list.
*Use note as wallpaper or lock screen image to easily remind yourself about your todo tasks with colorful stickies.
PERSONALIZE & SHARE

*Set default sticky note color, font size & name
*Personalise the notice board background
*Use the fully loaded text & draw toolbar with multiple font styles, sizes, thickness plus colors.

• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal

• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00098957:ios.description:
Hole Pool Jam – Dive into a Splashy Color Puzzle Challenge!
Get ready for the ultimate pool party puzzle in Hole Pool Jam – a fun, colorful, and addictive puzzle game where quick thinking and smart moves are the key to winning! With its relaxing gameplay, satisfying animations, and vibrant 3D pool theme, this game is perfect for fans of strategy games, brain teasers, and casual color puzzles.
Your goal? Move the pool hole around the map, guide all the swimmers into it before time runs out, and clear each level without getting jammed! But it’s not as simple as it looks – swimmers of different colors can block each other’s way, so you’ll need to plan ahead, manage your space, and solve the puzzle with precision.
How to Play:
Tap and drag to move your pool hole.
Swimmers of the matching color will rush toward the pool if they have a clear path.
Collect all swimmers of that color to fill your pool.
Avoid color collisions – one wrong move can block everything!
Complete the level before the timer runs out!
Why You’ll Love Hole Pool Jam:
Challenging yet relaxing gameplay – A perfect mix of brain training and chill fun.
Color-based puzzle mechanics – Easy to learn, tricky to master!
Smooth controls & satisfying movement – Just drag to dive!
Offline playable – Enjoy anywhere, anytime without Wi-Fi.
Hundreds of handcrafted levels – From simple to mind-bending.
Unique swimming pool theme – Cool, splashy, and visually refreshing!
Whether you're a fan of logic puzzles, color games, or just looking for a fun offline game to relax with, Hole Pool Jam is here to make a splash. It’s time to think smart, act fast, and collect all the swimmers without getting stuck!
Download now and become the master of the pool!

**[App Description]** 
Power the world with ChargerGoGo, your trusted companion for staying connected on the move. Never worry about a dying battery again—save your phone with one portable charger at a time. 
**[Problems Solved]** 
In today’s fast-paced, tech-driven world, our phones are lifelines—connecting us to loved ones, capturing memories, and sharing our stories. But there’s nothing more stressful than seeing your battery hit the dreaded red zone, especially when you're far from an outlet and on the go. 
That’s where ChargerGoGo steps in. With our easy-to-use app and network of portable charging stations, you can rent a power bank anytime, anywhere, and keep your phone alive wherever life takes you. 
**[Features]** 
- **Effortless Rental & Return:** Find a station through our app, scan the QR code, and grab a power bank. Return it to any station with open slots when you're done. 
- **Universal Compatibility:** Equipped with USB Type-C, Micro-USB, and Lightning connectors for iPhones. 
- **Powerful Capacity:** Each power bank offers 5000 mAh—enough to keep you charged through your busy day. 
Stay connected, stress-free, and fully charged with ChargerGoGo—download the app today!

bluejetty:00121726:ios.description:
Mind Fitness: Your daily mind flex with the best puzzle games!
Solve mysteries in a game full of adventures!
The master of a mysterious mansion left a message for a certain brave and clever detective. Is that you? Come on, take the clue: Open the envelope and start your adventure in the Manor. There are more mysteries here than you expected!
Let’s play the most mysterious hidden objects game ever! Unveil the secrets of Mystery Manor and meet all sorts of fantastic beasts, from fierce monsters to spooky ghosts, and try to search and find clues for your investigation. Solve challenging puzzles, find hidden artifacts, uncover secret rooms, investigate crime (occasionally, even an old murder!), search for evidence, and complete exciting quests. It will be a never ending journey! The master of the Manor keeps an eye on the mansion from afar and won’t ever let you get bored. With each new chapter you’ll see new quests, rooms, and characters, that appear in the manor every once in a while! The efforts of the seekers will be generously rewarded.
Some great feature highlights:
• Explore an atmosphere of mystery.
• A captivating detective story full of secrets, romance, crimes… and sometimes even murders.
• Beautiful hand-drawn graphics.
• A wide variety of objects to search for and puzzles to solve.
• Search for objects in different modes: words, silhouettes, phenomena, and Zodiac modes.
• Regular free updates full of new characters, rooms, and quests.
• Breathtaking mini-games and a Match-3 adventure.
• This game works offline without an Internet connection, so you can play it on the plane, on the subway, or on the road. Enjoy!
Enter Mystery Manor and compare it with all the other murder mystery games, detective games, and hidden object games you ever played: you are sure to see the difference for yourself! Looking for clues, finding evidence, solving criminal puzzles, chasing a killer — what can be more fascinating! Mystery Manor is a game where your attentiveness, wit and creativity really matter. 
Be ready for a breathtaking adventure that will be a wonderful escape from your everyday routine.

bluejetty:00084743:ios.description:
EduRev is the ultimate study app designed to maximize your academic performance while minimizing study fatigue. With EduRev, you get top-tier study notes, targeted video lessons, and interactive practice tests all in one easy-to-use digital platform.
Whether you need homework help for school, resources for homeschooling, or structured test prep for major admissions exams, our learning app adapts to your unique learning style and helps you achieve your goals.
We break down learning into a simple, highly effective cycle that builds long-term retention:
Learn: Access structured, expert-curated study guides, bite-sized video lectures, and chapter summaries that explain complex concepts simply.
Practice: Test your knowledge instantly with subject-specific quizzes, flashcards, and topic-wise worksheets.
Analyze: Review detailed analytics that show your strengths, highlight your weak areas, and provide a clear roadmap to improve.
Excel: Take timed mock exams and practice tests designed to replicate the exact format and difficulty of the real tests.
Comprehensive Test Prep & Academic Support: 
- School Curriculum (Grades 1 to 12/Year 1 to 13)
- Access chapter-wise study guides, interactive worksheets, and review materials for Mathematics, English Language Arts (ELA), Sciences, and Social Studies.
- Perfect for regular school enrichment, credit recovery, or homeschooling curriculum support.
- College Admissions & AP Test Prep
Master your admissions exams with extensive practice questions, instructional videos, and complete review notes.
SAT Prep & ACT Prep: Full-length practice tests, timed mock exams, and specific strategies for Math, Reading, and Writing sections.
AP Exams: Advanced Placement study resources for AP Calculus, AP Biology, AP Physics, AP US History, and AP English Literature.
Graduate & Professional Exams
Expert, high-yield courses designed for top-tier graduate programs.
GRE & GMAT: Comprehensive analytical and verbal reasoning reviews for Graduate School and MBA programs.
MCAT & LSAT: Tailored lessons, practice passages, and strategies for Medical and Law school applicants.
English Language Proficiency
TOEFL & IELTS: Targeted vocabulary practice, listening modules, reading comprehension tips, and full study guides.
Study Anywhere, Anytime
Offline Mode: Download your study materials, flashcards, and notes to study on the go—even without an internet connection.
Flexible Academic Plans
Access a massive library of high-quality learning resources. Ready to supercharge your test prep? Upgrade to the EduRev Infinity Plan to unlock more courses and resources, comprehensive test prep materials, and in-depth academic notes.

bluejetty:00125230:android.summary: "How Many - Trivia Game is the ultimate brainy challenge that will leave you exposed to the world of word games and brain games! Test your IQ with mind-boggling trivia and brain tests. Unravel puzzles, stack knowledge, and embark on an offl
bluejetty:00125230:android.description:
"How Many - Trivia Game is the ultimate brainy challenge that will leave you exposed to the world of word games and brain games! Test your IQ with mind-boggling trivia and brain tests. Unravel puzzles, stack knowledge, and embark on an offline journey of excitement!
In this challenging and fun quiz game, you'll face thousands of unique and challenging trivia questions that test your knowledge of various topics and categories. With multiple game modes, you'll be entertained for hours as you play through quizland, answering questions and trying to outdo your friends in trvia. In each round, you'll be presented with a question and a list of possible answers, and you'll have multiple ways to respond. You can try to answer the question directly by selecting one of the multiple choice options, or you can try drawing a number with your finger on the screen. The game will use image recognition technology to try to understand the number you've drawn and provide you with a corresponding answer.
If you're not sure of the correct answer, you can also try guessing. The game will keep track of how close your guess is to the correct answer, and if nobody knows the correct answer, the player with the closest guess will win the round. As you progress through the game, the questions will become more difficult, so you'll need to use all of your knowledge and problem-solving skills to get as far as possible. With features reminiscent of popular games like trivia star, hq trivia, and triviacrack, you'll feel like you're playing a round of preguntados with friends. Whether you're a trivia buff or just looking for a fun quiz to pass the time, this game has something for everyone.Compete with friends in this thrilling trivia crack and become the trivia king. Guess answers, answer funny surveys, and have fun like never before. From Scrabble to Kahoot, this game has it all! Dive into the world of jeopardy, show off your brainpower, and conquer the top ranks.
Get ready for an IQ test that will buzz your brain with exhilarating quiz games. How Many brings you an unforgettable experience of word games and brain teasers. Download now and enjoy endless hours of fun!"

bluejetty:00089079:ios.name: BattleRise: Adventure RPG
bluejetty:00089079:ios.summary:
Tactically Enchanting. Magically Unlimited. 
BattleRise: Kingdom of Champions is a collectible, role-playing game combining gripping turn-based battles, an engaging story-mode, and endless dungeons (and with even more features planned for
bluejetty:00089079:ios.description:
Tactically Enchanting. Magically Unlimited. 
BattleRise: Kingdom of Champions is a collectible, role-playing game combining gripping turn-based battles, an engaging story-mode, and endless dungeons (and with even more features planned for the future). BattleRise is inspired by fan-favorite, classic, fantasy-themed games, yet has its own look and feel.
In the world of Eos, an immeasurably powerful creature and his henchmen threaten all the realms of the living. Your task in this epic and perilous quest to save the world is to unite brave, foolhardy, battle-hardened warriors in an epic struggle against these ancient evils threatening to annihilate all of creation.
• Experience a world teeming with adventure and evil 
• Encounter other Champions in the arena
• Fight through endless dungeons to retrieve legendary loot
• Craft and customize powerful Artifacts
• Strategize on and off the battlefield to vanquish opponents 
• And seize rich rewards!
Rise up to the many challenges that BattleRise has to offer in the Kingdom of Champions!
DUNGEON RUN
Scour for legendary loot and epic bonuses in shrines, and face Tiamat’s heralds on the paths of the treacherous dungeons. Choose your Champions and strategy wisely to get through all the challenges and prevail.
Every Dungeon Run is directly affected by the decisions you make along the way: 
• Which Gods you ask for a blessing
• Which ally Champions you choose 
• Which abandoned shrine you inspect
All these choices bring benefits and consequences that directly influence the story and the progress of that specific run, changing your experience. Each step you decide changes the outcome in some way. 
You can play a single Dungeon Run many times over before you get through every possible combination, allowing you to discover new depths of the lore every time you play.
ARENA
Clash with others in the gripping synchronous PVP battles for one sole purpose - the taste of victory! Step into the grandest arena of all and let your name be known among other players.
CHAMPIONS
Unite and rise with Champions from a wide range of iconic backgrounds. Choose from a host of formidable factions such as sanctified Seraphim, Verdant Offspring, and Void Lords. Explore dozens of Champions bringing unique skills and stories. Many more Champions are planned over time.
Every single Champion brings something different to the table. It is up to you to learn what each of them does best and find ways to combine their skills and abilities in the optimum way. Many Champions have built-in synergy with each other, allowing them to work as a team seamlessly. 
There are many permutations of team composition to cater to your preferred playstyle. Will you rush your opponent to bring them down before they even get a turn? Or do you enjoy the battle and prefer to take your time? The choice is yours!
ARTIFACTS
The world of Eos is full of legendary weapons, ancient artifacts, and magic spells!
Find the treasure and experiment enabling viable Champions with your collectibles. The artifacts can enhance their powers in various ways. Play and seek the best setup for your Champions. The possibilities are many. The choices are yours!
STORY
Delve into the world of Eos! Embark on adventures inspired by fan-favorite, classic, fantasy themes. Multiple quests and immersive stories await you. 
FOUNTAINS OF LOOT
All your battle hardship shall be well compensated! 
Indulge in the feeling of the classic Hack ’n’ Slash games:
• Slay monsters 
• Find treasure
• Uncover magic 
• Seize those artifacts to best even the greatest adversaries!
LEARN MORE:
• Website: https://www.battlerise.com
• Discord: https://discord.gg/BattleRise
• Twitter: https://twitter.com/BattleRiseGame
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/battlerise/
• Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCaEbxRxHiXVkwckIU1mG6aA 
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/battlerise_official/

Your task in this epic and perilous quest to save the world is to unite brave, foolhardy, battle-hardened warriors in an epic struggle against these ancient evils threatening to annihilate all of creation.

• Experience a world teeming with adventure and evil 
• Encounter other Champions in the  arena
• Fight through endless dungeons to retrieve legendary loot
• Craft and customize powerful Artifacts
• Strategize on and off the battlefield to vanquish opponents 
• And seize rich rewards!

Rise up to the many challenges that BattleRise has to offer in the Kingdom of Champions!


DUNGEON RUN

Scour for legendary loot and epic bonuses in shrines, and face Tiamat’s heralds on the paths of the treacherous dungeons. Choose your Champions and strategy wisely to get through all the challenges and prevail.

Every Dungeon Run is directly affected by the decisions you make along the way: 

• Which Gods you ask for a blessing
• Which ally Champions you choose 
• Which abandoned shrine you inspect

All these choices bring benefits and consequences that directly influence the story and the progress of that specific run, changing your experience. Each step you decide changes the outcome in some way. 

You can play a single Dungeon Run many times over before you get through every possible combination, allowing you to discover new depths of the lore every time you play.

 
ARENA

Clash with others in the gripping synchronous PVP battles for one sole purpose - the taste of victory! Step into the grandest arena of all and let your name be known among other players.


CHAMPIONS

Unite and rise with Champions from a wide range of iconic backgrounds. Choose from a host of formidable factions such as sanctified Seraphim, Verdant Offspring, and Void Lords. Explore dozens of Champions bringing unique skills and stories. Many more Champions are planned over time.

Every single Champion brings something different to the table. It is up to you to learn what each of them does best and find ways to combine their skills and abilities in the optimum way. Many Champions have built-in synergy with each other, allowing them to work as a team seamlessly. 

There are many permutations of team composition to cater to your preferred playstyle. Will you rush your opponent to bring them down before they even get a turn? Or do you enjoy the battle and prefer to take your time? The choice is yours!

 
ARTIFACTS

The world of Eos is full of legendary weapons, ancient artifacts, and magic spells!

Find the treasure and experiment enabling viable Champions with your collectibles. The artifacts can enhance their powers in various ways. Play and seek the best setup for your Champions. The possibilities are many. The choices are yours!


STORY

Delve into the world of Eos! Embark on adventures inspired by fan-favorite, classic, fantasy themes. Multiple quests and immersive stories await you. 


FOUNTAINS OF LOOT

All your battle hardship shall be well compensated! 

Indulge in the feeling of the classic Hack ’n’ Slash games:
 
• Slay monsters 
• Find treasure
• Uncover magic 
• Seize those artifacts to best even the greatest adversaries!

• See a fresh, personalized verse on your Lock Screen
• Open Bible chat with one tap from the widget
• Receive quick insights that invite prayer and reflection for your day
Highlights
• Meaningful conversations with guidance shaped to your questions
• Personalized study plans with clear step-by-step routes tailored to your goals

- A conversation-first Bible app with an AI companion that makes Scripture easy to access, understand, and apply.

- Many users feel encouraged after their first verse and chat. Deeper growth comes from a few focused minutes each day.
- Do I need prior Bible knowledge?
- No. Ask anything. Biblical explains context, themes, and application in plain English.
- Which translations are included?
- Popular versions such as NIV, ESV, CSB, NRSVUE and NRSV

Flex your fingers and fill your backpack with powerful swords, armor and weapons to unleash the true power of your smile! With the right strategy, you can dominate the battle, harness the power of attackers and weapons, and control monsters with exciting game decisions.
But remember, Rumble Bag is not just a typical rpg adventure game; it's a whole new world in your backpack! With dozens of heroes to summon and merge, there are always new strategies to try in your backpack. Get ready to face endless waves of monsters. In your backpack, explore a unique roguelike skill experience with infinite combinations that make every battle unique. Do you have what it takes to strategize, can you survive the war and create a legend?
Strategize, make decisions, and enjoy this very fun casual game. But remember, Rumble Bag is not just about battles, it's about how you strategize and add a touch of intelligence to leisure with an extremely relaxing and fun game.
Let's see what Rumble Bag, a game that tests your strategic skills and backpack management, has to offer:
【Heroes galore】With a backpack and strategy, summon and merge dozens of heroes to build your ultimate battle team.
【Endless battles】Strategize to fend off waves of monsters and bosses waiting to test your skills.
【Skill experience】Experience a new roguelike skill with endless combinations thanks to great strategy and a backpack full of options.
【Casual excitement】This casual game is a perfect blend of fun and strategy that will keep you entertained.
Rumble Bag truly redefines what it means to combine strategy and fun! So why wait? Put on your backpack, hone your strategy, and enter a world of epic battles, engaging strategies!
Get your backpack ready, hone your strategy, and download Rumble Bag now!

bluejetty:00091440:ios.summary:
FluxKey is an AI keyboard that rewrites, corrects and translates your text inside the apps you already use. Select text, tap an action, and the result replaces it right there. No copying, no pasting, no switching apps.
WHAT THE KEYBOARD CA
bluejetty:00091440:ios.description:
FluxKey is an AI keyboard that rewrites, corrects and translates your text inside the apps you already use. Select text, tap an action, and the result replaces it right there. No copying, no pasting, no switching apps.
WHAT THE KEYBOARD CAN DO
• Paraphrase: rephrase a sentence so it reads clearly and naturally, and pick from several versions
• Check Grammar: fix spelling, grammar, punctuation and capitalization while keeping your own wording
• Change Tone: make a message sound friendly, professional, confident, witty and more
• Humanize: smooth out stiff, repetitive or generic-sounding text so it reads like you wrote it
• Reply: paste a message you received and get a short, natural reply you can edit before sending
• Translate: turn your text into one of 20 languages, including Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Hindi and Arabic
• Ask: type a question and get a ready-to-paste answer
• Rizz: give a text a smoother, more confident spin
• Encrypt and Decrypt: scramble a message into text that can only be read back by decrypting it with FluxKey
• Swipe typing and fancy fonts: glide across the keys to type, or switch to script, gothic, outline, bold, monospace and small-caps styles
MORE IN THE APP
• Writing workspace: paste longer text, then fix, rewrite or reply in one tap and copy a clean result
• Chat: a built-in assistant that runs on your iPhone when Apple Intelligence is turned on
• Keyboard themes: choose a styled look such as Matcha, Frost or Neon Edge, or keep the system default
WORKS WHERE YOU TYPE
Messages, WhatsApp, Mail, Instagram, Notes, Slack, Safari and most apps that use the standard keyboard.
COMMON QUESTIONS
How do I paraphrase text on iPhone? Add FluxKey in Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards, switch to it in any app, select your text and tap Paraphrase.
Can FluxKey make AI-written text sound more natural? Yes. Humanize rewrites stiff or generic phrasing in plain, varied wording while keeping the meaning.
Does FluxKey work without internet? AI actions need an internet connection and Full Access. Typing, swipe, fonts and themes work offline.
SUBSCRIPTION
FluxKey Premium unlocks the keyboard's AI actions. Available plans:
• Weekly: $7.99 per week, auto-renewing
• Yearly: $39.99 per year, auto-renewing
• Lifetime: $99.99, one-time purchase, does not renew
Payment and renewal:
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings at any time after purchase.
• Cancelling stops future renewals. 
• Prices are in US dollars and may vary in other countries.

bluejetty:00094709:ios.description:
ARE YOU THE PUZZLE MASTER WE'VE BEEN LOOKING FOR? 
Dive into the most colorful and captivating puzzle adventure of the year! If you love the brain-teasing challenge of games like Screw Master 3D and Screwdom, but are ready for a fresh, new theme, then Unravel Master is your next addiction! Get ready to untangle, strategize, and solve your way through a world of wonderfully tangled yarn.
Unravel Master: Your Zen Wool Challenge! 
This isn't just a game; it's a relaxing escape for your mind. Unravel Master combines mind-bending logic puzzles with a soothing, stress-free atmosphere. The challenge will test your brain, while the vibrant visuals and smooth gameplay will calm your soul.
A VIBRANT WORLD OF COLORFUL YARN 
Forget cold metal screws and bolts! Immerse yourself in a visually stunning universe filled with brilliant, soft lines of yarn. Each level is a unique piece of art, waiting for a master strategist like you to bring order to the beautiful chaos. Watch as tangled messes transform into satisfyingly neat patterns with every correct move you make!
HOW TO PLAY: Unravel The Yarn! 
The goal is simple, but the challenge is immense:
Examine the Yarn Object: Carefully observe the overlapping and knotted lines of yarn.
Pick a Pin: Tap a color of yarn and collect 3 of the same color to an empty socket.
Unravel Strategically: Plan your moves to unravel the yarn one by one. A wrong move could make you lose the level!
Achieve Perfection: Successfully unravel all the yarn to complete the level and feel the ultimate satisfaction!
AWESOME FEATURES 
HUNDREDS OF BRAIN-BOOSTING LEVELS: With a difficulty curve that starts easy and becomes fiendishly complex, you'll never run out of puzzles to solve. If you conquered Screwdom, you'll find a familiar and exciting challenge here!
STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS & RELAXING SOUNDS: Lose yourself in the smooth animations and a calming soundtrack. It's the perfect game to play to de-stress after a long day.
INTUITIVE ONE-TOUCH CONTROLS: So easy to learn, you can start playing instantly. But don't be fooled—mastering the art of the unravel requires true skill.
HELPFUL HINT SYSTEM: Stuck on a particularly tricky knot? Just like in top puzzle games like Screw Master, our hint system is here to give you a little nudge in the right direction.
DAILY CHALLENGES & REWARDS: Come back every day for unique new unraveling levels and earn amazing rewards to keep your experience fresh and exciting!
Ready to swap screws for string and become a legend of untangling? Your next favorite puzzle game is just a tap away.
Download Unravel Master NOW for FREE and prove you are the ultimate puzzle-solving champion!

bluejetty:00083105:ios.name: ErgData
bluejetty:00083105:ios.summary: ErgData from Concept2 is your personal training partner. Set up workouts from your phone or tablet, view customized stats and information during workouts, track your progress, sync with the Concept2 Online Logbook, take part in the Workout
bluejetty:00083105:ios.description:
ErgData from Concept2 is your personal training partner. Set up workouts from your phone or tablet, view customized stats and information during workouts, track your progress, sync with the Concept2 Online Logbook, take part in the Workout of the Day and much more. 
Features
-Set up workouts from your phone, making it simple to create even the most complex of interval workouts. You can choose to store workouts as favorites or rerow past efforts straight from ErgData.
-Set the Concept2 Workout of the Day on the monitor with a single tap.
-Compatible with the Apple Watch. Watch users can now see real-time heart rate data on the screen during the workout and in analysis afterwards.
-Choose from different workout display options, including small, medium and large data screens, a pace graph screen, an interval and split table or a pace boat. Easily swipe between screens during your workout. Customize the data shown to suit you.
-Syncs with the Concept2 Online Logbook, making it easy for you to take part in our many challenges. From the Online Logbook, your workouts can get sent to platforms such as Strava, Garmin Connect or Training Peaks.
-Detailed post-workout analysis helps you know exactly what happened during your workout. See all your interval and split data, as well as pace and rate graphs, plus how long you spent in each heart rate zone.
-Optional voice guidance to send audible workout data and results. 
Technical Specifications
-Compatible with the PM5.
-Compatible with the Concept2 RowErg, SkiErg and BikeErg
-Connects to Apple Health
-Connects to PM5 via Bluetooth only
Note: Please do not have a USB stick in the PM5 at the same time as using ErgData, as this may prevent workouts being saved.

bluejetty:00015965:ios.description:
"Duncan Price is paranoid," they used to say. He's just the local nut.
They used to say a lot of things about him.
Now they don't say anything.
Because they're dead.
You awaken in what appears to be your father's abandoned bunker with no idea how you got there. Last night was wild... but not that wild.
A familiar voice crackles over an old two-way radio. It's your sister. She tells you you've been locked inside for your own safety.
She's trapped too.
If you want to save her, you'll need to escape the bunker, uncover the truth behind your family's past, solve ingenious puzzles, and discover what happened before you're...
...all that remains.
Explore every corner, collect useful items, uncover hidden clues, and unravel a chilling mystery in this immersive first-person escape room adventure from Glitch Games.
Features
* Immersive first-person point-and-click adventure.
* Escape room gameplay filled with clever puzzles and hidden secrets.
* Explore a mysterious underground bunker packed with interactive environments.
* Collect items, combine objects, and solve challenging puzzles.
* Use the unique Glitch Camera to capture clues and help solve mysteries.
* Built-in clue system to keep you moving without spoiling the challenge.
* Atmospheric original soundtrack that brings the world to life.
* No in-app purchases—buy once and enjoy the full game.
* Auto-save ensures your progress is always safe.
* Available in English (UK & US), French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
If you enjoy escape room games, point-and-click adventures, mystery games, hidden object puzzles, or brain-teasing logic games, you'll love uncovering the secrets hidden beneath the bunker.

bluejetty:00064140:ios.summary: Spades is a trick-taking card game that can be played with 3 players solo, 4 players solo, or 4 players with partners (2 teams of 2). A standard 52-card deck is dealt, then players bid the number of tricks they can take. The goal is to take
bluejetty:00064140:ios.description:
Spades is a trick-taking card game that can be played with 3 players solo, 4 players solo, or 4 players with partners (2 teams of 2). A standard 52-card deck is dealt, then players bid the number of tricks they can take. The goal is to take as many tricks as were bid. When playing with partners, North/South is one team, West/East is the other, and teammates' bids and tricks are combined, so one player's underbid can compensate for his teammate's overbid.
This app allows you to configure number of players and teams, the appearance of the table and cards, rules about nil bids and when spades can be lead. There are instructions included in the app, as well as a setting to make your robot opponents less aggressive or more aggressive.

Welcome to the world of the Myths of Ancient Greece! 
Here you will encounter gods and goddesses, nymphs and cyclopes, as well as the amazingly beautiful Mediterranean world full of exciting adventures and glorious feats!

bluejetty:00080858:ios.description:
Oh no! The enemy is attacking our home.
Pick your weapons, gather your soldiers, and protect your home. Join the battle in War Inc: Rise now!
### Protect Your Home
Every night, waves of enemies come to break our defenses and destroy our home. Collect weapons, expand your land, and call on your soldiers to guard the gates and keep our home safe. Watch out for the big bosses that show up and cause massive damage.
### Fight in Different Game Modes
- PVE: Clear levels, unlock more weapons and face new challenges.
- PVP-Coop: Team up with friends or family to take down strong enemies.
- PVP: Defend your base against other players.
- Boss Fights: Gather your troops and use different weapons to defeat the bosses.
- Guild Wars: Fight for your guild and win together.
### Unlock and Upgrade Weapons, Soldiers, and Your Home
Unlock powerful weapons and unique soldiers. Upgrade your home base with strong defenses and new features. Plan your strategy and outsmart your enemies!
### Become the Best Player
Join competitions and events to climb the leaderboards. Show off your skills and collect rare items. Prove you’re the top commander!
### Always Getting Better
Regular updates bring new content and challenges. Stay ahead with the latest strategies and improvements. Enjoy fresh gameplay every time you log in!
### Play with Friends, Family, and Rivals!
Team up with friends and family for cooperative battles. Compete against other players to see who’s the best. Enjoy a fun and rewarding multiplayer experience!
### What's New
- Battle alone or with friends against players from around the world.
- Fast-paced PVE and PVP-Coop modes designed for mobile.
- Unlock and collect new, powerful weapons with special attacks and abilities.
- Daily events and game modes.
- Build Your Home: Create a safe and resource-rich base.
- Climb the leaderboards in global and local rankings.
- Join or start a clan to share tips and fight together.
### Cool Features
- Mix and Match: Use different soldiers and strategies to win.
- Make Friends: Team up with other players and win together.
- Be the Best: Show everyone you're the top player.
- Get Rewards: Find valuable items to make your soldiers and home better.
- Watch and Learn: See battles and learn new tricks.
- Lots to Do: From solo missions to team challenges, War Inc: Rise has something for everyone.
### From the Makers of Art of

bluejetty:00039568:ios.description:
Discover Echo, the ultimate app for changing voices, creating original music, and harnessing the power of advanced artificial intelligence. Echo combines cutting-edge AI technology with endless creative possibilities, offering realistic voice cloning, AI-generated music, professional voice effects, and vocal isolation — all in one app.
Key Features:
● Voice Cloning
Clone any voice with remarkable accuracy. Record or upload audio to create a digital twin of any voice. Create exclusive content using your own voice or iconic voice styles — realistically and easily.
● AI Music Creation
Write your lyrics, pick a genre — pop, trap, synthwave, rap, and more — and generate a full original track in seconds. Echo transforms your words into professional-sounding songs powered by AI.
● Voice Changer & Effects
Modify audio recordings with fun and creative effects. Apply pitch shifting, filters, and voice transformations perfect for personalized messages, social media content, or just having fun.
● Vocal Isolation
Separate vocals from any song or audio file instantly. Extract acapella vocals or instrumental tracks — ideal for remixes, karaoke, covers, and music production.
● Celebrity-Style Voices
Experience how AI recreates iconic voice styles. Generate realistic text-to-speech audio with a wide variety of distinctive voices. Perfect for content creators, dubbing, and voiceovers.
● Professional Dubbing
Create professional-quality dubbing for videos, advertisements, podcasts, and presentations using advanced AI voice technology.
● AI Text-to-Speech
Convert any text into natural, lifelike speech. Choose from hundreds of voice options across multiple languages. Studio-grade audio quality at 44.1kHz/192kbps.
Why Choose Echo?
● All-in-one AI audio studio — voice cloning, music creation, effects, and vocal isolation in a single app
● Studio-grade audio quality — 44.1kHz/192kbps output
● Continuously updated voice library and AI models
● Simple, intuitive interface for all skill levels
● Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Indonesian, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, and more
Echo is perfect for:
● Content creators and influencers seeking professional audio quality
● Musicians and producers looking for AI-powered music tools
● Podcasters needing voiceover and dubbing solutions
● Anyone who wants to explore the creative possibilities of AI voice and music
How to Use Echo:
1. Enter text, upload audio, or write lyrics
2. Choose your voice style, music genre, or audio effect
3. Generate your content with one tap
4. Download, share, or keep creating

bluejetty:00069223:ios.description:
Buddhism knowledge will help you to be mindful in a present moment! Mindfulness is the psychological process of bringing one's attention to experiences occurring in the present moment. Basic mindfulness meditation – sit quietly and focus on your natural breathing or on a word or “mantra” that you repeat silently. Get the app to be get some mindfulness and inspirational quotes and teachings.
This Buddha wisdom and knowledge app will give you beautiful teachings and sayings of the Buddha, Buddhism and much, much more...
In this app, you will not only get beautiful sayings and teachings from Buddhism but, you will also get striking images which make the message from the Buddha stand out. 
There is so much that you will get from this app, you don't want to miss out! This includes things like: 
. Buddhism Meditations
. Buddhism Quotes 
. The Four Noble Truths
. Different Buddhism Chapters
. Parables 
. Truth
. And, Dhammapada
Follow the spiritual teachings of the Buddha; the spiritual and enlightened teacher who founded Buddhism. Follow his wisdom and apply it in every area of your life!
We have started to add Guided Audio Meditations. We are recording them in professional studio. Buddhist meditation is the practice of meditation in Buddhism and Buddhist philosophy. Buddhism meditation encompasses a variety of meditation techniques that aim to develop mindfulness, concentration, supramundane powers, tranquility and insight (vipassanā, vipassana). 
The Buddhism quotes in this app will help you in so many ways. It will help you to gain peace, tranquillity and happiness. The more that you read these quotes and think about them, the more these quotes will benefit you in your everyday life. 
The Four Noble Truths will help you to gain a better understanding of Buddhism. The Four Nobel Truths comprise of the Buddhas teachings. As the name suggests, it gives you four main truths from Buddha. These truths are the truth of suffering, the truth of how you can end suffering, the cause of your suffering and the path of truth which leads you to end suffering. 
The different Buddhism chapters in this book will help you to gain a better understanding of Buddha and Buddhism. They are a great read. Try and read them a few times to get the best out of them. They give you beautiful illustrations which help you to bring to life the essence of Buddha and his teachings.
Introducing our latest update! Immerse yourself in the transformative world of mindfulness with our brand-new audio meditation collection: Impermanence. Discover a serene path to self-discovery, where you can cultivate acceptance and embrace change through guided meditations. Dive into the Impermanence collection and embark on a journey of profound reflection, leading to a greater sense of tranquility and balance. With our carefully curated meditations, you'll find the wisdom and tools to navigate life's transitions with grace. Download now and explore the power of Impermanence for a more mindful you.

bluejetty:00087382:ios.description:
Our catalogueoffers.com.au app shows you all the current catalogues from small and large chain stores in Australia, and not just the supermarkets and builders merchants, but also electronics stores, fashion stores, toy stores, computer stores, pharmacies and many more. We have even included most of the local stores. Do you want to select a store as a favourite, you can simply do this by clicking on the love heart. This way you will always be the first to know about any promotions that are going at your favourite stores, and you will have created a handy collection of all your favourite catalogues. 
Are you looking for a special on a specific item or product? You can find these quickly by selecting them in the menu of our app. This way you get an overview of where the item can be found in the catalogue, at what price and how much longer that deal remains valid. Usually you can select the item from the catalogue with just a single click, after which you can easily order it from the web shop. Of course you can also save the specials by using our save-function at the bottom of the browse program. You can then quickly find these back at a later stage or you can compare them with other specials.
Why choose for the Catalogueoffers.com.au app
- The biggest catalogue offer in Australia, containing all catalogues! 
- THE catalogue app for iPhone and iPad.
- Always the most recent catalogues, first available online
- Both national as well as regional catalogues
- Option to select new catalogues, popular catalogues, catalogue tips or nearly expired catalogues
- View catalogues per category or store, or choose a theme 
- All your favourite catalogues together in a clear overview
- Also view magazines, brochures, catalogues or lookbooks
- Save promotions and make your own shopping list
- Access to adresses of the available stores near you, that are open right NOW.
Because we are independent, we can offer you all catalogues, both nationally as well as locally, without any restrictions. Our motivated team is online daily, in order to be the first to place the latest catalogues for you. And because we don’t distribute any paper catalogues, we are also better for the environment! That means an advantage for the environment and an advantage for you. 
Will you help us improve? Send us your comments, tips and questions to: info@catalogueoffers.com.au. Of course your review would also make us very happy. 
The Catalogueoffers.com.au app is brought to you by catalogueoffers.com.au; the most comprehensive catalogue site in Australia for 3 years. With all the catalogues, promotions, discounts and specials, from A to Z, and lots of advantages and discounts for you.

bluejetty:00070024:ios.name: Idle Barber Shop Tycoon - Game
bluejetty:00070024:ios.summary:
Are you ready to own a barbershop and become the best barber in town? 
Take on the challenge and become rich while running your family business!
Start with your grandad’s old furniture and work hard to make your reputation grow. Improve e
bluejetty:00070024:ios.description:
Are you ready to own a barbershop and become the best barber in town? 
Take on the challenge and become rich while running your family business!
Start with your grandad’s old furniture and work hard to make your reputation grow. Improve every detail and turn your small business into a stylish hair salon able to please all kinds of customers with the most innovative hairdressing techniques!
Deal with the needs of your facilities and take the proper decisions to expand your business and bring fame and prestige to your premises: customize and change the decoration; implement new hairdressing services; offer new beard, mustache, and haircut styles; use hairdressing supplies like gels, hairdryers, combs, brushes, razor blades, or new hair dyes… Make choices and see their impact on your character’s evolution!
ENJOY THE STORY WHILE PLAYING AN IDLE GAME: 
Follow the main character’s storytelling as you advance in the idle game! Take advantage of all the features an idle game includes and, at the same time, find out the different stories of people that come to your barbershop. Some of them may help you with your business during the progress.
MEET AND INTERACT WITH LOTS OF CHARACTERS!
Discover new people while advancing in the story! With their help, you will be able to turn your modest hair salon into a successful reference in your city. Talk with all of them, know more about their lives, make friends, and maybe find your ideal partner!
SELECT COUNTLESS STYLES
Be the perfect hairdresser and make a difference by offering a wide range of hairstyles. Unlock new skills and tools so you and your staff could shave, curl, cut, wash, dye, trim, or comb in many different ways! Improve your reputation and start making more and more money thanks to all the creative ideas you could provide to your customers. Be ready for the most demanding clients and learn as many hairdressing techniques as possible! Specialize also in mustaches, sideburns, goatees, and beards, or use the boldest hair colors to make your clients look great. 
MANAGE OUR WORK TEAM 
Your barbershop needs the proper staff to meet your customers’ needs! Work hard to be a worthy boss and find the best employees to cover all the business requirements. Build a solid work team and know their strengths and weaknesses throughout their own stories.
If you like incremental and idle games, you will enjoy Idle Barbershop Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to grow an old familiar business with profitable results. Improve your premises starting with the basics and unlock visible progress in your establishment. Transform your small business into the most competitive barbershop in the city and become the best manager! 
Features: 
- Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
- Story + Idle game concept
- Constant challenges 
- Dozens of hairstyles and razor services
- Lots of characters and interactions
- Numerous objects to be unlocked
- Funny 3D graphics and great animations with hipster vibes
- Management of a successful business
- Follow your own love story

bluejetty:00127643:ios.description:
Do you love Action Sports? Then you're going to love FUEL TV+, the global home of action sports.
With roots going back to 2003, FUEL TV+ provides streaming access to an incredible array of premium and award-wining programming, including the entire FUEL TV library of more than 2,000 hours of series, movies, events and specials.
Our line-up includes professionally produced content from the worlds of Surfing, Snowboarding, Skiing, Skateboarding, BMX, Mountain Biking, Motocross, Adventure, Music, Art, Fashion, and Culture.
To watch FUEL TV+ you can subscribe on a monthly or annual basis with an auto-renewing membership right inside the app. Subscribe once and watch on all of your favorite screens.

• Resume playback across all devices linked to your account
• Save videos to watch later with Watchlist
• Cast to your big screen via Chromecast and AirPlay
• Access previously viewed programs in your Library.

bluejetty:00141086:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in historical events with the unrivaled casual shooter Blitzkrieg Assault: War Zone! and prevent the train from breaking through in this representative of WW2 strategy games with tower defense elements. Be ready to confront
bluejetty:00141086:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in historical events with the unrivaled casual shooter Blitzkrieg Assault: War Zone! and prevent the train from breaking through in this representative of WW2 strategy games with tower defense elements. Be ready to confront the unstoppable armored train, in this challenge, all you have is your shooting skills and a powerful machine gun, but with each successful destruction of the cars you are given the opportunity to level up skill cards. Feel the experience of a war zone and endless fun in a casual TD game with unique mechanics of shooter and WW2 strategy games.
Download Blitzkrieg Assault: Idle Tower Defense! and play today for free!
Unique Gameplay: Play as a brave commander who defends the base from the battle train using a machine gun and shooting skills. You are waiting for a combination of casual arcade, TD games, and stationary shooter and everything happens in the theme of WWII.
Unrivaled Combat Upgrades: for successful battles and repelling train attacks, you can choose improvements during the level: piercing shots, ricochets, increased ammunition, attack speed and damage from shots, and many others. Also, after completing the mission, you are given the opportunity to level up your commander, this is equipment with a special upgrade and a skill tree, and change the character.
Constantly Increasing Difficulty: in Blitzkrieg Assault: WW2 Strategy Games, your opponent is a combat train with a large number of cars that are constantly becoming stronger: increasing their armor, installing guns, increasing speed, becoming impenetrable, and many other enhancements. To protect the base in this casual shooter you will have to not only skillfully aim and shoot accurately but also use tactics.
Immersive and Catchy Design: in this arcade, you will see eye-pleasing animation with a bunch of bright effects. Pleasant 3D graphics combined with the WWII theme will give you a great immersion in the gameplay and leave a good impression of TD games.
AIM AND SHOOT
Are you ready for the difficult challenges of TD games that stand in the way of a brave warrior? Dive into the thick of the war zone, pick up a machine gun, and try to defend your base against the boss train in a unique casual shooter. Blitzkrieg Assault: Idle Tower Defense is an immersion in the theme of WW2 strategy games with unique gameplay and non-stop fun.

Are you ready for the difficult challenges of TD games that stand in the way of a brave warrior? Dive into the thick of the war zone, pick up a machine gun, and try to defend your base against the boss train in a unique casual shooter. Blitzkrieg Assault: Idle Tower Defense is an immersion in the theme of WW2 strategy games with unique gameplay and non-stop fun.

bluejetty:00063994:ios.description:
Instantly correct lighting and exposure and transform your photos and videos into something extraordinary.
Relight is a realtime HDR app with eight unique modes that correct lighting and exposure issues, add artistic HDR effects, enhance details, and more. With single image HDR tone mapping techniques, you can edit your existing photos and you’ll see the effects in your camera preview before you snap - letting you capture HDR images without missing a moment. Relight lets your camera see closer to what you see.
Relight also allows you to apply HDR effects to your videos and record live 1080p HDR videos.
Modes
Over 50 artistic and photo enhancement/correction presets across eight special modes:
• Enhance - Improve lighting, contrast, and color to give your photos a more natural to the eye look
• Low Light - Improve dim lighting and correct exposure problems
• Artistic - Add creative HDR effects to your photos
• Clarity - Bring out details and enhance local contrast to make your photos stand out
• Sky - Enhance contrast in the sky to create a distinct look
• Dramatic - Heighten the emotion of your photos with bold lighting
• Overexposure - Improve washed-out and overexposed photos
• Fog - Reduce fog and haze to bring life to otherwise dull photos
Features
• Universal app for iPhone and iPad
• Realtime HDR lets you see the effect before you snap, so you don’t miss a second
• Full range of adjustments to get just the right look
• Over 50 unique color filters to make your photos special
• Load photos from your Camera Roll, iCloud, and other Albums
• Share your creations on Instagram, Twitter, and Facebook
• Support for TIFF and other output formats
• Transform your videos with HDR effects
• Record live 1080p HDR videos
Subscribe or purchase Relight to unlock all features.
For more information, visit us at www.codeorgana.com, or follow us on Twitter and Instagram @codeorgana.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00030149:ios.description:
Whether you're a boater, property owner, fisherman, paddler, whitewater rafter, or someone who works or lives near the water, Rivercast® makes it easy to see exactly what's happening on the rivers that matter to you.
Rivercast includes:
• Over 12,000 active gauges across USA
• Official flood warnings and alerts from the National Weather Service
• River stage height in feet
• River flow rate in CFS (when available)
• Color indicators showing when a river is normal, rising, or flooding
• Current observations and recent history
• Custom river level alerts when a river reaches your chosen level (Premium feature)
• NOAA river forecasts (when available)
• Interactive Map showing all nearby river gauges
• Search by waterway name, state, or NOAA 5-digit station ID
• Interactive Graphs with pinch-to-zoom and pan
• Add your own reference lines to graphs for landmarks or safety levels
• Favorites list for quick access to your key locations
• Share graphs via iMessage, Email, Facebook, and more
• Full Dark Mode support
• Companion Apple Watch app to monitor your favorites (Premium feature)
• Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy Mode Widgets to monitor your favorites
Rivercast’s map not only shows where gauges are located, but color-codes them to indicate whether each station is at normal levels, approaching flood stage, or above flood stage.
Tap any location to view the latest observations or open an interactive graph for detailed trends. Pinch or drag to zoom and pan, or tap and hold for precise readings using the crosshair tool.
Customize your hydrographs with personal level markers for bridges, sandbars, rocks, or safe navigation levels. Add favorite gauges for quick monitoring anytime.
Rivercast uses official NOAA observation and forecast data and requires an internet connection for data access. Data is displayed in feet or cubic feet per second (CFS) when available, always shown in your local time.
A trusted tool for boaters, fishermen, property owners, paddlers, scientists, and marine professionals who need clear, reliable river information.
River gauges reported are USA only.
We take our accuracy seriously!
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * 
Some Frequently Asked Questions:
Where does Rivercast get its data?
This app uses NOAA sources for its raw data for our custom graphing and mapping solutions. Some locations available only from other agencies (such as USGS) may not appear in this app.
Why does Rivercast sometimes show slightly different flow data (CFS) than USGS?
CFS is a calculated estimate derived from stage height. NOAA and USGS may sometimes use different data models, so results can vary slightly—usually within a few percent. Stage height should always be identical between NOAA and USGS, and designated flood stages are usually based on height in feet.
Why does Rivercast only show observations, but not forecasts, for my river?
NOAA provides forecasts for many, but not all, monitored rivers. Some forecasts are seasonal or only issued during high-water events.
My river gauge was there yesterday, but it’s gone today. Why?
River gauges occasionally have technical issues transmitting data or may even be washed out during flooding. Some are also seasonal. NOAA typically restores data within a few days or weeks.
Can you add location XYZ to your app?
We wish we could! If NOAA doesn’t report data for that location, we unfortunately can’t include it. Rivercast displays all stations that NOAA provides for public use.
For more information, visit www.RivercastApp.com

Disclaimer: Rivercast is not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA, USGS, or any other government entity.

bluejetty:00108376:android.summary: What if 🇮🇳 Hindi vocabulary learning would be a crazy fun game instead of boring memorisation drills? Drops makes Indian language learning an effortless fun. Practical vocabulary is bound to your memories through beautiful graphics and quic
bluejetty:00108376:android.description:
What if 🇮🇳 Hindi vocabulary learning would be a crazy fun game instead of boring memorisation drills? Drops makes Indian language learning an effortless fun. Practical vocabulary is bound to your memories through beautiful graphics and quick mini-games.
The crazy part? You have only 5 mins per day. Might sound insane but works like charm! :)
These are the ingredients of the secret sauce:
👀 100% illustrated: Pictures directly carry the meaning - you don’t have to use your native language at all! No intermediary. Faster, more effective and of course more fun! :)
🏎 5 min sessions: limiting practice time sounds crazy but it it makes it incredibly addictive - which is cool thing for learning. The barrier of entry is close to zero so you can’t have any excuses: you’ll have 5 minutes even on the busiest day!
🕹 Effortless play: We know why games are fun and addictive and distilled the essence into Drops. The result is a truly immersive experience but it’s not waste of your time while you play because you build a valuable knowledge.
⚡Qucik: Keyboard typing is painfully slow. Welcome rapid swipes and taps! Trust us, you’ll need those extra seconds during the quick learning session ;)
🎯 Vocabulary only: Zero grammar, just handpicked practical words. That’s our focus and we do it extremely well. The app teaches the Korean “alphabet” Hangul (hangoul) too!
💁Forge a habit: Drops wants to make you language learning addict. Effectiveness is nothing without a well established habit. We help you build one!
We are extremely proud of our lovely word pronunciations by seasoned voice talents!
Drops is free for casual learners: more than 1700 words in 99 topics are all available for everyone. Hardcore language learners can subscribe for premium to progress faster with unlimited learning time. Subscriptions start from $2.99 / month.
🌍 Our goal is to empower people of the world via language knowledge by providing a special tool that utilizes the universal language we all speak: pictures.
p.s.: be careful, this app really can get you addicted to to language learning.
-----------------
😍 If you love Drops as much as we enjoyed building it, please leave us a review! :)
Questions? Contact us at sup@languagedrops.com

bluejetty:00140796:ios.name: MindNode: Mind Map & Outline
bluejetty:00140796:ios.summary:
Your brain doesn't think in straight lines. MindNode doesn't force it to. Capture scattered thoughts, connect them in a mind map, and turn them into a clear outline, plan, or project structure.
DESIGNED FOR EVERY KIND OF THINKER
• Persona
bluejetty:00140796:ios.description:
Your brain doesn't think in straight lines. MindNode doesn't force it to. Capture scattered thoughts, connect them in a mind map, and turn them into a clear outline, plan, or project structure.
DESIGNED FOR EVERY KIND OF THINKER
• Personal Productivity: organize your week, track life goals, and plan your next vacation
• Students & Educators: create study guides, summarize lectures, and plan your essay structure
• Business Professionals: visualize project roadmaps, prepare meeting agendas, and plan strategy
• Creatives & Writers: outline your novel, plan your content calendar, and brainstorm campaigns
THINK: EXPLORE AND CAPTURE
• Mind Maps: branch, cluster, and grow ideas freely on an infinite canvas
• Outline View: switch to a structured, hierarchical list whenever a linear flow helps
• Live Collaboration: brainstorm with others in real time and always stay in sync
CLARIFY: STRUCTURE AND REFINE
• Visual Tags: categorize ideas and spotlight what matters
• Connections: draw links between nodes that go beyond hierarchy
• Notes: tuck extra detail into any node, hidden until you need it
• Focus Mode: dim everything except the work in front of you
• Folding: collapse whole branches for a cleaner view
ACT: FROM THOUGHT TO IMPACT
• Tasks: turn ideas into actions, synced with Apple Reminders
• Apple Shortcuts: automate your recurring workflows
• Document Linking: connect nodes across separate documents
• Import and Export: OPML, Markdown, PDF, SVG, PNG, and more
EXPRESS: MAKE IT YOUR OWN
• Themes: choose a curated look or build your own, with automatic light and dark mode
• Layouts and Shapes: arrange nodes your way and pick from a range of node shapes
• Images, Stickers, and Emoji: enrich your maps with over 250 custom stickers and more
AI, A THINKING PARTNER, NOT A REPLACEMENT 
MindNode treats AI as a sparring partner for your thinking, never a substitute for it. You stay in control of every idea.
• Suggest a starting structure or expand a branch with a tap
• Turn a finished map into a written draft, or summarize a long document
• Powered by Apple Intelligence where available, with its privacy protections built in
ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, native on each
• On Vision Pro, gather your thoughts as colorful pills floating in space and connect them by hand
• Automatic iCloud sync, with offline changes merged when you reconnect
• Localized in 13 languages, with VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your ideas stay yours. Documents are stored encrypted in your own iCloud, not on our servers, and even live collaboration is end-to-end encrypted, so only you and the people you invite can read your work. MindNode is a small independent team in Europe, owned by its founder and answerable to its users, not investors.
FREE
• Capture ideas as mind maps, edit, rearrange, fold, and view them as an outline
• Sync across all your Apple devices, and export your ideas in open formats so you are never locked in
MINDNODE PLUS
• Adds outline editing, Notes, Visual Tags and Connections, Tasks, Focus Mode, Apple Shortcuts, Document Linking, SVG export, AI, and full theming, across every platform
• Available monthly or yearly
QUESTIONS?
We value excellent customer support. When you contact us, you will always reach a human. We're always happy to help: support@mindnode.com
Terms of Service: https://mindnode.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mindnode.com/privacy

bluejetty:00137026:ios.summary:
Remove unwanted people, objects, and text from your photos with a tap or by brushing over an area. Easy Photo Eraser & Retouch fills in the selected area to blend with the surrounding background.
Clean up travel photos, remove distracting
bluejetty:00137026:ios.description:
Remove unwanted people, objects, and text from your photos with a tap or by brushing over an area. Easy Photo Eraser & Retouch fills in the selected area to blend with the surrounding background.
Clean up travel photos, remove distracting clutter, or make small blemishes less noticeable with this iPhone photo editor. Want to change something instead? Use AI Replace to describe what you want in the selected area, or choose a preset such as "Blue sky" or "Brick wall".
■ Great for
- Removing tourists and passersby from travel photos
- Erasing power lines, trash, signs, and cars from landscapes
- Removing text, date stamps, and logos from photos and screenshots
- Cleaning up cables and clutter in product and room photos
- Making blemishes and acne less noticeable
■ Pick a photo and mark what to remove
1. Choose a photo from Photos, Files, or iCloud Drive
2. Tap or brush over what you want to remove
3. Tap "Erase" to remove the selected area and fill it in, then save your photo
Your original photo is never changed. Edits are saved as a new photo.
■ Features
◆ Tap to select people and objects
AI recognizes people and objects in your photo, and you select one with a tap. Switch between "Broad" and "Fine" selection.
◆ Brush for precise selection
Brush over small spots or thin wires with your finger. A magnified view shows where you are brushing. Use the Eraser tool to deselect areas you don't want to change. You can also expand, shrink, or invert the selection.
◆ Auto-select people, text, and barcodes
Detect and select the people, text, or barcodes in a photo. You can try automatic text detection for free, but saving a photo edited with it requires Pro. Brushing over text to erase it is free.
◆ Erase and fill the background
The selected area is removed and filled to match its surroundings, entirely on your iPhone.
◆ Replace selected areas with a text prompt
Generative AI changes the selected area based on the text you enter.
AI Replace requires an internet connection. The image data and instructions needed for the edit are sent to a server for processing.
◆ Compare and share your results
Hold "Compare" to view the original, or create a Before/After video to share on social media.
■ Free vs. Pro
The free version includes tap selection (Broad), brush selection, standard Erase, and saving in standard quality.
Pro adds:
- Unlimited "Fine" auto-select
 (free version: once per photo)
- Automatic text detection
- Editing and saving in high quality
 (standard: up to 1920 px on the long edge; high: up to 4032 px)
- No ads
Choose a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase for lifetime access to Pro.
■ FAQ
Q. Can I remove text from photos for free?
A. Yes. Brush over the text and erase it. Saving a photo where text was selected with automatic detection requires Pro.
Q. What is the difference between "Erase" and "AI Replace"?
A. "Erase" removes the selected area and fills it from the surrounding background. It runs on your iPhone and needs no connection. "AI Replace" regenerates the selected area based on your text prompt and is processed online.
Q. Can I use AI Replace for free?
A. Yes. In the free version, you may need to view or watch an ad to use AI Replace. Availability depends on whether an ad is ready. Pro removes ads.
Q. Will the erased area look natural?
A. The background is filled based on surrounding patterns and textures. Results vary by photo and selection. For large areas, try the "Complete background" preset in AI Replace.

- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.
