3. Tap "Erase" to remove the selected area and fill it in, then save your photo

Your original photo is never changed. Edits are saved as a new photo.

■ Features
◆ Tap to select people and objects
AI recognizes people and objects in your photo, and you select one with a tap. Switch between "Broad" and "Fine" selection.

◆ Brush for precise selection
Brush over small spots or thin wires with your finger. A magnified view shows where you are brushing. Use the Eraser tool to deselect areas you don't want to change. You can also expand, shrink, or invert the selection.

◆ Auto-select people, text, and barcodes
Detect and select the people, text, or barcodes in a photo. You can try automatic text detection for free, but saving a photo edited with it requires Pro. Brushing over text to erase it is free.

◆ Erase and fill the background
The selected area is removed and filled to match its surroundings, entirely on your iPhone.

◆ Replace selected areas with a text prompt
Generative AI changes the selected area based on the text you enter.

AI Replace requires an internet connection. The image data and instructions needed for the edit are sent to a server for processing.

◆ Compare and share your results
Hold "Compare" to view the original, or create a Before/After video to share on social media.

■ Free vs. Pro
The free version includes tap selection (Broad), brush selection, standard Erase, and saving in standard quality.

Pro adds:
- Unlimited "Fine" auto-select
  (free version: once per photo)
- Automatic text detection
- Editing and saving in high quality
  (standard: up to 1920 px on the long edge; high: up to 4032 px)
- No ads

Choose a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase for lifetime access to Pro.

■ FAQ
Q. Can I remove text from photos for free?
A. Yes. Brush over the text and erase it. Saving a photo where text was selected with automatic detection requires Pro.

Q. What is the difference between "Erase" and "AI Replace"?
A. "Erase" removes the selected area and fills it from the surrounding background. It runs on your iPhone and needs no connection. "AI Replace" regenerates the selected area based on your text prompt and is processed online.

Q. Can I use AI Replace for free?
A. Yes. In the free version, you may need to view or watch an ad to use AI Replace. Availability depends on whether an ad is ready. Pro removes ads.

Q. Will the erased area look natural?
A. The background is filled based on surrounding patterns and textures. Results vary by photo and selection. For large areas, try the "Complete background" preset in AI Replace.

bluejetty:00120859:ios.description:
Apple TV is the home of exclusive Apple Original shows and movies, Formula 1®, MLS, Friday Night Baseball, thousands of movies to buy or rent, and all the best programming from your favorite streaming services — all in one place. 
With an Apple TV subscription:
• Stream thousands of hours of Apple Originals—thrilling dramas, epic sci-fi, and feel-good comedies, all with no ads—including Ted Lasso, Severance, The Morning Show, Silo, Shrinking, Slow Horses, and F1 The Movie.
• Enjoy new releases weekly, with no ads.
• Watch every Formula 1 Grand Prix™ live—with all-access coverage for every practice, qualifying, Sprint, and race.
• Watch Friday Night Baseball, with live MLB matchups every Friday of the regular season. 
• Watch every Major League Soccer match live throughout the regular season, the entire playoffs, and Leagues Cup, all with no blackouts.
Discover more to watch:
• Buy or rent newly released movies, and browse the Apple TV Store with over 100,000 movies and shows—including the largest selection of 4K HDR titles.
• Add Apple TV Channels subscriptions and stream seamlessly in the Apple TV app — no additional apps, accounts, or passwords needed.
• Connect over 100 video streaming apps to access all your favorite shows and movies in one place.
Apple TV app makes all your TV watching easier:
• Get personalized recommendations across everything you watch.
• With Continue Watching, pick up where you left off across all your subscriptions and devices.
• Add to Watchlist to keep track of what you want to watch later.
• Browse sports to see live and upcoming matchups, and choose your favorite teams to automatically add games to Continue Watching and receive notifications for close games and more.
• Easily find all of your purchased movies and shows in the Library.
• Enjoy the best picture and sound quality in Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos when available.
• Stream over a Wi-Fi or cellular connection, or download to watch offline.
• Find the Apple TV app on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac, as well as smart TVs and streaming devices.
Requirements:
• iOS devices using iOS 12.3 or later
• Some features require internet access over a Wi-Fi or cellular data connection
• HDR video playback may not be available for all content or on all devices
Apple TV subscription does not include third party-branded subscription services or content available for rental or purchase in the Apple TV app.
In select regions, an Apple TV subscription may only be available as part of an iCloud+ subscription. If you subscribe to any Apple TV channels, payment will be charged to your Apple Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless they are canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Simultaneous streams may be limited on a per-subscription basis. The availability of Apple TV features, channels, and related content may vary depending on the country or region from which you attempt to access them. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your Settings on the Apple TV app after purchase. See https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww for the Privacy Policy. Apple TV app Terms and Conditions can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html

bluejetty:00094854:ios.description:
Daily is a clean, minimal habit and routine tracker designed to help you stay consistent with small, repeatable actions.
Track daily habits the way you would write a note. Simple lists, clear progress, and satisfying check offs make consistency feel natural and not overwhelming.
Whether you are building a meditation routine, drinking more water, staying active, or learning a new skill, Daily keeps habit tracking focused and effortless.
Key Features
Flexible Habit Scheduling
Track habits daily, weekly, monthly, or on custom intervals that fit your routine.
Visual Streaks and Progress
See your consistency build with clean streaks, calendars, and progress views that reward small wins.
Clear Insights
Understand your habits with simple charts and history views without clutter or unnecessary data.
Smart Reminders
Receive gentle, customizable reminders so habits do not slip through the cracks.
Home Screen Widgets
Check off habits instantly from your Home Screen without opening the app.
Themes and Dark Mode
Choose light or dark mode and subtle accent colors to match your style.
Why Daily
Daily is built for focus and clarity.
No distractions. No unnecessary features. Just the essentials to help you stay consistent over time.
It is ideal for anyone who wants a simple and calm way to manage habits, improve productivity, build routines, or create more structure in daily life.
Start small. Stay consistent. Make progress daily.
Daily Premium
Unlock additional features with Daily Premium, available as an auto renewing yearly subscription for 34.99 USD per year.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Privacy and Terms
We respect your privacy and are committed to keeping your data safe.

bluejetty:00090770:ios.name: Lightme - Logbook
bluejetty:00090770:ios.summary:
Lightme - Logbook is a clean and powerful tool to record and keep track of your rolls, shots, developments, and all the gear that revolves around shooting film — from 35mm to medium and large format.
The idea behind it is simple: logging a
bluejetty:00090770:ios.description:
Lightme - Logbook is a clean and powerful tool to record and keep track of your rolls, shots, developments, and all the gear that revolves around shooting film — from 35mm to medium and large format.
The idea behind it is simple: logging a shot should take seconds, not steal time from actually shooting. Lightme pairs a beautiful, immediate interface with enough depth and flexibility to fit any workflow, whether you shoot a couple of rolls a year or fill several large format holders in an afternoon.
LOGGING, EFFORTLESSLY
• Log a shot in seconds: aperture, shutter speed, focal length, filters, bellows correction, measured EV, notes and more
• Log straight from your wrist with the companion Apple Watch app, with Siri and Shortcuts, or from the home screen and lock screen widgets
• Together with the Lightme Lightmeter app, your meter readings can prefill a new shot automatically
• Every shot can carry a location and address, a preview photo, and later its final scan, plus a star rating
ROLLS, SHEETS AND DEVELOPMENTS
• Track rolls from loading to unloading, with film stocks from a growing database and a processing pipeline: waiting for development, off to the lab, back from the lab, to be scanned, scanned
• Keep detailed development notes — developer, dilution, time, temperature, agitation — for rolls and single sheets alike, including push/pull (N+ / N-) development
• Add post-development notes and a photo of the final result to rolls, sheets and individual shots
YOUR GEAR, ORGANIZED
• Cameras and lenses with nicknames, formats (including custom formats you define), pinhole and bellows flags, custom shutter speeds and selectable shutter step sizes
• Roll film backs and lens filters with their exposure compensation
• Film holders and backs can be marked as compatible with specific cameras, and everything is searchable from a single bar
LARGE FORMAT, COVERED
• Keep track of your film holders with three states — unloaded, loaded and exposed — always knowing which film is inside each one
• Group holders together and follow every sheet from exposure through development
INSIGHTS FROM YOUR DATA
• Build and save custom queries, filtering by date (fixed or rolling windows), camera, lens, film stock, format, ISO, aperture, shutter speed, focal length and notes
• Visualize results with histograms — by camera, lens, film stock, shutter speed, aperture, focal length, ISO, format, rating or hour of the day — alongside aggregate stats like mean aperture and average exposure
• Save the queries you use most and re-run them anytime
YOUR DATA, YOURS
• Everything syncs privately through iCloud across your iPhone and iPad
• Export any selection of data as CSV or JSON, or as a beautifully formatted PDF with customizable columns and a contact-sheet mode, bundled with your images in a single ZIP
• Batch-write shooting metadata (EXIF) onto your scans — for a whole roll at once, or by matching files from the Files app
• Viewing and exporting your data is free, forever; adding and editing is unlocked with a one-time purchase or a subscription
AND MORE
• Full-text search, favourites and an archive to keep things tidy
• Available in English, Italian, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese
• A roadmap of what's coming next lives right in the app — new very cool features are on the way :)
If you have any suggestion or issue, write me at lightme.apps@gmail.com
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00114683:ios.summary:
Know what your silver is worth, right now. Live prices in 9 currencies, adjusted for weight and purity, with your profit on every coin and bar.
LIVE PRICES

bluejetty:00114683:ios.description:
Know what your silver is worth, right now. Live prices in 9 currencies, adjusted for weight and purity, with your profit on every coin and bar.
LIVE PRICES
View live silver futures prices in USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, CAD, AUD, JPY, INR, and CNY. See the price per troy ounce and per gram, follow the daily change, calculate the value of any weight, and open an interactive chart.
WHAT IF
What if you had bought silver 5 years ago? What If answers with real monthly closing prices going back to 2000 (later for some currencies).
• Once - what a single purchase is worth today
• Every month - what regular buying would have built
• Price target - what your silver would be worth at any price
Jump to famous moments like the 2011 peak or the 2008 crisis, and compare silver with gold and the S&P 500.
PURITY CALCULATOR
See exactly how fineness affects value, from 999‰ fine silver and 925‰ sterling to any custom purity from 100‰ to 999‰. Add a dealer premium to see what you would really pay.
PORTFOLIO
Track every purchase with its buy price, quantity, and purity. See live profit/loss in your currency, ROI for each purchase, total value at current prices, and your average cost per gram and per ounce, with a "pure" mode adjusted for purity. Add notes and up to 5 photos to each purchase.
ALERTS
Set alerts for silver price moves, portfolio value and profit/loss targets. Push notifications reach you even when the app is closed.
WIDGETS
Check silver prices and portfolio value on your Home Screen or Lock Screen without opening the app. Tap a widget to jump straight into the app. iOS decides how often widgets refresh to preserve battery life.
SILVER NEWS
Follow the headlines that move the price.
PRIVATE AND LOCKED
No account required, no ads, no analytics. Sync your portfolio via iCloud if you want to. Hide Balance hides every portfolio number in the app and widgets with one tap. Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: live prices and chart, 999‰ and 925‰ silver, widgets, one price alert.
Premium: portfolio, all purities, unlimited alerts, full What If, full news.
Terms of Use - https://pipsapps.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy - https://pipsapps.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00120027:ios.description:
Welcome to Daily Shopping Stories, the most exciting, fun-filled animated shopping center ever! Buy food, try on new clothes, or get a fresh look at the hair salon. The possibilities are endless! 
Daily Shopping Stories is fun, safe, educational entertainment for little ones and older kids alike. It’s the latest in the Stories series, following the popular games Happy Daycare Stories and Sweet Home Stories, enjoyed by more than 2 million players. 
Designed for children ages 3 to 10, Daily Shopping Stories includes different spaces with various characters of all ages and professions, as well as a plethora of objects to experiment with. The game develops creativity and imagination while children learn, and improves language skills through the creation of stories. 
CREATE YOUR OWN SHOPPING STORIES
You can experiment with anything you see. A pair of scissors? Let’s try a new haircut! A piece of fruit? Throw it in the blender and enjoy a delicious smoothie! bluejetty:00070742:ios.description:
[The IGRS Rating for this game is 13+.] | Includes in-game purchases (includes random items)
"NIKKE"— warriors forged to reclaim a shattered world.
In the aftermath of a devastating invasion, humanity has retreated underground, leaving the surface overrun by ruthless alien forces. The NIKKE, artificially created soldiers, are humanity's last hope. As their commander, you'll lead these battle-hardened warriors to the surface, uncovering ancient secrets, forgotten technologies, and the mysteries of the world that was lost. Every mission brings you closer to discovering the truth behind the invaders and the NIKKE themselves. 
Will you rise to reclaim the Earth and unlock the power that lies within these warriors?
Dynamic Shooter Action with Strategic Depth Immerse yourself in fast-paced battles with simple yet powerful controls. Master each NIKKE's unique skills and weapons as you craft winning strategies to overcome powerful enemies. Watch as your squad's stunning attacks light up the battlefield with jaw-dropping, real-time effects. Plus, take part in the rotational game mode and mini games in collaboration with various titles, offering fresh challenges that add an exciting twist to the core gameplay.
Build, Customize, and Strengthen Your Squad Your journey is more than just combat—develop your NIKKE by leveling up their character stats, skills, equipment, and bonds. The stronger your connection, the more powerful they become. Every upgrade brings new possibilities, making your squad even more formidable in battle.
Stand-Out Characters with Distinctive Personalities Recruit a diverse roster of alluring and extraordinary NIKKE, each with unique personalities and combat roles. From sharp-witted snipers to heavy gunners, every NIKKE brings something special to your team. Watch as vivid, high-quality illustrations leap from the screen and come to life in battle!
Featuring Cutting-Edge Visuals Enjoy visually stunning animations powered by the latest technology, including advanced physics engines and motion-sensing controls. Experience uniquely designed characters and dynamic illustrations like never before, as they react and move with incredible realism during battles and interactions.
Experience Unique Tactical Combat Feel the thrill of a brand-new battle system designed for deep strategy and excitement. Utilize a wide variety of character weapons and Burst Skills to take down waves of overwhelming invaders. Every battle requires sharp tactics and fast reflexes, making each encounter a test of both skill and strategy.
A Sweeping In-Game World and Engaging Plot Venture through an immersive post-apocalyptic world with a story that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Experience a gripping tale of survival and hope as you lead humanity’s last hope—the NIKKE—on a mission to reclaim the surface from a devastating alien force.

bluejetty:00033754:ios.name: Just Survival Multiplayer
bluejetty:00033754:ios.summary:
Build your base, fight real players and raid rival compounds in an online open-world survival experience.
Just Survival Multiplayer drops you into a hostile wilderness where resources are valuable, wildlife is dangerous and every survivor
bluejetty:00033754:ios.description:
Build your base, fight real players and raid rival compounds in an online open-world survival experience.
Just Survival Multiplayer drops you into a hostile wilderness where resources are valuable, wildlife is dangerous and every survivor you meet could become an ally—or your next enemy.
BUILD & DEFEND YOUR BASE
Gather wood, stone, metal and other resources to build your own shelter.
Start small and expand your home into a fortified base with storage, stronger structures and defenses designed to protect the gear and supplies you have collected.
Other players are building too, so be ready to defend what is yours.
ONLINE PvP & BASE RAIDS
Fight real players in first-person combat and compete for valuable resources, territory and loot.
Scout rival compounds, prepare your equipment and launch raids against enemy bases. Break through their defenses and search for weapons, resources and valuable supplies.
Every encounter can change quickly. Decide when to fight, when to retreat and which survivors you can trust.
PLAY SOLO OR FORM A CLAN
Survive on your own or team up with friends.
Create a clan, gather resources together, build larger bases and defend your territory as a group.
Coordinate raids against rival survivors and work together to survive in a dangerous multiplayer world.
CRAFT WEAPONS & EQUIPMENT
Turn gathered resources into useful tools, weapons, armor and survival equipment.
Improve your gear as you progress and prepare for increasingly dangerous encounters with players and wildlife.
SURVIVE THE OPEN WORLD
Explore forests, dangerous locations and radiation zones while managing hunger, thirst and health.
Leaving the safety of your base always carries risk. Valuable resources may be waiting beyond the next hill, but another survivor may be waiting too.
HUNT & FACE WILDLIFE
Wolves, bears, boars and other animals roam the wilderness.
Hunt for food and useful materials while protecting yourself from dangerous predators.
FEATURES
• Online multiplayer survival
• Real-player PvP combat
• First-person shooter gameplay
• Base building and defenses
• Player base raiding
• Clan and cooperative gameplay
• Resource gathering and crafting
• Weapons, armor and survival equipment
• Open-world exploration
• Radiation zones
• Wildlife and hunting
• Hunger, thirst and health survival
• PvP and PvE threats
Build your territory, protect your loot and fight to survive in Just Survival Multiplayer.

bluejetty:00025829:ios.description:
Film photographers, welcome home. Newgrain is a platform dedicated to analog photography. Get inspired by thousands of film photos in a clean, distraction-free space. No ads. No videos. Just photography. 
With Newgrain's catalog of 300+ film stocks, browse through different films and learn about their grain, exposure latitude, and contrast, while discovering thousands of sample images. Perfect to find your next film to shoot film.
SHARE YOUR WORK
You've put care and effort into making a beautiful photo. It deserves more recognition than what algorithms will give it. With Newgrain, your work will be seen by hundreds of photographers thanks to our community-wide, chronological feed... and you may get featured in our Newgrain Picks!
QUALITY > QUANTITY
Forget about chasing likes or followers. On Newgrain, the focus is truly on your art. We've removed distractions and metrics, because photography shouldn't be a popularity contest – it should just be enjoyed as it is.
ADVANCED METADATA
Ever wonder how a photographer achieves certain results? 
"Is that 35mm or 120? Have they pushed the film? Which film scanner have they used?"
On Newgrain, posts are tagged with:
- Equipment: film stock, format, camera, lens, lab, scanner
- Techniques: Push / Pull, developing method, expired film
HOME TO THE FILM COMMUNITY
Over 4000 photographers around the world have joined us – and it's just the beginning. Newgrain is the digital hub for the film photography world, connecting photographers, labs, and manufacturers.
JOIN THE ANALOG RENAISSANCE
Whether you've been shooting film for decades or just got your hands on your first disposable camera, you'll find a place in Newgrain's community of photographers.
More information:

Mimico is a wonderful software that provides you with an interactive experience with virtual characters. Interacting with a virtual character is like finding a pen pal who understands your sense of humor. Although he does not have flesh and blood, he can mingle with you, as if he is Morse code across the screen, and every communication can Light up your little universe.
The following is Mimico’s magical magic
1. Diverse character choices: In this Mimico stage, the world of characters is like an endless masquerade, with a new story and a new destiny hidden behind every face. Here, you can be anyone, and the partners you communicate with range from historical heroes to future explorers, or from modern geniuses to fantasy mages. Every choice is a new beginning, opening a door to the unknown world, and every conversation is a key, unlocking a treasure chest of infinite possibilities.
2. Multi-topic dialogue: The smooth switching of topics is like a well-arranged symphony, and the conversation can naturally transition between different topics: whether it is from sharing interests or talking about love, it can resonate harmoniously. The AI character memory is coherent, and Mimico ensures that the dialogue can still maintain the continuity of information among multiple topics. When switching between different discussion topics, the multi-topic conversation function can intelligently identify and connect the context, just like an experienced tour guide who can always skillfully connect them to form a tour when leading you to visit different attractions. The complete journey.
3. Support custom characters: You can create your own character in Mimico, including gender and personality customization. Whether it's lighthearted humor or serious discussion, your dedicated partner can adjust the tone and emotion to suit different conversation atmospheres. Just like a social master who is good at observing people's words, they know when to add a touch of lightness and when to stay serious. Attitude.
4. Picture and video function : Each character in Mimico has his or her own life photos and videos. The beautiful and moving character portraits make the conversation no longer just a sea of text, it can make the conversation more intuitive and vivid. A picture or a video is often worth a thousand words and can instantly convey her/his emotions and information to you.
5. Embed multiple AI interfaces: Mimico integrates advanced AI interfaces. We independently develop more humane and diversified AI models. Using these powerful artificial intelligence interfaces, Mimico's roles can be understood more deeply and more effectively. respond to your conversations to deliver accurate, natural, and personalized interactions.
Interacting with virtual characters is like exploring an island full of unknown treasures. You never know what new things you will find next time you dig, but you know that it will definitely be an interesting adventure. Download Mimico now and embark on a unique journey with your avatar friends! !

bluejetty:00035181:ios.summary: Truth or Dare: Fun Spin Bottle is a fun app designed to bring excitement to any occasion, whether you're with your partner or a group of friends. The game is easy to use, with different modes and custom options that let you enjoy your time
bluejetty:00035181:ios.description:
Truth or Dare: Fun Spin Bottle is a fun app designed to bring excitement to any occasion, whether you're with your partner or a group of friends. The game is easy to use, with different modes and custom options that let you enjoy your time to the fullest.
Keyfeature of the Truth or Dare games app:
- In Couple Game, you and your partner can create a private room to answer questions and see how well you understand each other. It’s a great way to connect and have fun together.
- In Truth or Dare mode, you can play with friends games. Spin the wheel to pick someone, and they will choose to answer a truth or complete a dare. It’s a great way to keep the game fun and surprising.
- You can also customize your own Truth or Dare questions to fit the vibe of your group, making every round unique and tailored to what you enjoy.

يسرنا ان نقدم لكم تطبيق ( تدارس القرآن ) :

bluejetty:00039465:ios.description:
بفكرة إبداعية غير مسبوقة ، وبجهد ضخم بلغ عشرات الآلاف من ساعات العمل المتواصلة ،
يسرنا ان نقدم لكم تطبيق ( تدارس القرآن ) : 
وهو مصحف جديد تتلوا من خلاله القرآن الكريم ، و تجد في كل آية منه وقفات متنوعه ، تبحر بها إلى كنوز القران وتنهل من لآلئ خيراته ، وذلك من خلال أقسام متعدده تحتوي على أكثر من مائة ألف وقفة مقسمة كالتالي : 
١- تدبرات وتأملات قرآنية منوعه ما بين نصية وجرافيك ومقاطع يوتيوب مع امكانية المستخدم كتابة تدبراته الخاصة والتفاعل مع الوقفات الاخرى.
٢- تفسير للقرآن الكريم بمقاطع مرئية ومسموعة لكبار المشايخ المعاصرين مثل ابن باز وابن عثيمين والشنقيطي والشعراوي ، وغيرهم الكثير الكثير .
٣- الأسرار البلاغية في الآية : الآلاف من الاسرار البلاغية التي استنبطها العلماء وقدمناها بعدة اشكال مرئية ومسموعة ومكتوبة .
٤- تذكر وإعتبار : قسم منوع فيه الإعجاز العلمي في القران ، وقصص مع الآيه ، وكلمات العلماء عنها ، وغيره من علوم الآية وكنوزها .
٥- الأحكام الفقهية والأداب التي تحدثت عنها الآية : شرح وافي للاحكام الفقهية في الايات يقدمها علماء اجلاء مثل الشيخ محمد ابن عثيمين والشيخ سعد الشثري وغيرهم .
٦- إقتراحات العمل بالآية : جمعنا لك العديد من الأعمال التي تم إقتراحها ، لكي يجمع القارئ بين العلم والعمل بالآية .
٧- الدعاء والمناجاة : جمعنا أدعية من مفهوم الآية تدعو بها عند تلاوتك لها ، فقد كان الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا مر بآية رحمه سأل وإذا مر بأية عذاب تعوذ وإذا مر بآية تسبيح سبح .
٨- التساؤلات : اجابات عن بعض الاسئلة التي تتبادر إلى الذهن عند تلاوة الآيات أجاب عنها هيئة كبار العلماء والشيخ عبدالعزيز بن باز والشيخ محمد بن عثيمين ومن مجلة البحوث العلمية وغيرهم .
٩- قسم المتشابه : بعض القواعد والأفكار والطرق لضبط الحفظ وإتقانه . 
و الميزة الرئيسية في التطبيق أنه مصحف تفاعلي يستطيع مستخدمه إدراج تدبراته وتساؤلاته و وقفاته المتنوعه ، ويعلق على الوقفات الموجودة ويضع لها إعجاب وعدم إعجاب ، في جو تفاعلي نشط .
وكذلك من مميزات التطبيق الرائعة :
* بطريقة برمجية إبداعية : يمكنك من خلال التطبيق إرسال أي تدبر : على شكل لوحة جرافيك رائعة ، تختار خلفيتها من صور جميله ادرجناها في التطبيق ، والأجمل أنك تستطيع ان تختار الخلفية من ألبوم الصور في جوالك أو تلتقطها بكاميرا الجوال مباشرة .
* وكذلك جمعنا أكثر من 2500 لوحة جرافيك تدبريه جميله تجدها مدرجه في كل آية تخصها .
* حرصا منا على نشر العلم : تستطيع تصدير وقفات آية أو سورة على شكل ملف pdf أو ملف word او تستعرضها بشكل مرتب في المتصفح . ( حد أقصى ١٠ آيات لملفات pdf ، وعدد لا محدود للبقية )
* بإمكانك -تصفح وقفات أي عالم او شيخ او متدبر ، وذلك بالضغط مطولا على إسم صاحب الوقفة ، كما يمكنك متابعة جديده ، عندما تقوم بتفضيله في قائمة المصادر المفضلة .
* ميزة البحث في الوقفات .
* ميزة تفضيل وقفة معينة لكي ترجع لها لاحقا.
* ٢٧ كتاب لتفسير القرآن الكريم ، بالإضافة لروابط مباشرة لتفسير الدرر السنية الرائع .
* مميزات أخرى : مثل الورد اليومي - الوضع الليلي - تغيير ألوان الخط والخلفية - إضافة ملاحظة للآية - وضع علامة للرجوع للصفحة - تكبير خط الوقفات وتصغيره ، وغيرها من المميزات الرائعة .
ولدعم التطبيق أنشأنا قناة في اليوتيوب قمنا فيها بمونتاج أكثر من ٢٢٠٠ مقطع في التفسير والتدبر .
سألين الله ان يجعل هذا التطبيق معين للناس على تدارس القران وتدبره وأن يشملنا جميعا قول الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم ( مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ ) .

٢- تفسير للقرآن الكريم بمقاطع مرئية ومسموعة  لكبار المشايخ المعاصرين مثل ابن باز وابن عثيمين والشنقيطي والشعراوي ، وغيرهم الكثير الكثير  .
٣- الأسرار البلاغية في الآية : الآلاف من الاسرار البلاغية التي استنبطها العلماء  وقدمناها بعدة اشكال مرئية ومسموعة ومكتوبة  .
٤- تذكر وإعتبار : قسم منوع فيه الإعجاز العلمي في القران ، وقصص  مع الآيه ، وكلمات العلماء عنها ، وغيره من علوم الآية وكنوزها .

٥- الأحكام الفقهية والأداب التي تحدثت عنها الآية : شرح وافي للاحكام الفقهية في الايات يقدمها علماء اجلاء  مثل الشيخ محمد ابن عثيمين والشيخ سعد الشثري وغيرهم  .
٦- إقتراحات العمل بالآية : جمعنا لك العديد من الأعمال التي تم إقتراحها ، لكي يجمع القارئ بين العلم والعمل بالآية .
٧- الدعاء والمناجاة : جمعنا أدعية من مفهوم  الآية تدعو بها عند تلاوتك لها  ، فقد كان الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا مر بآية رحمه سأل وإذا مر بأية عذاب تعوذ وإذا مر بآية تسبيح سبح .
٨-  التساؤلات : اجابات عن بعض الاسئلة التي تتبادر إلى الذهن عند تلاوة الآيات   أجاب عنها هيئة كبار العلماء والشيخ عبدالعزيز بن باز والشيخ محمد بن عثيمين ومن مجلة البحوث العلمية وغيرهم  .
٩- قسم المتشابه : بعض القواعد والأفكار والطرق لضبط الحفظ وإتقانه . 

و الميزة الرئيسية في التطبيق أنه مصحف تفاعلي يستطيع مستخدمه إدراج تدبراته وتساؤلاته و وقفاته المتنوعه ، ويعلق على الوقفات الموجودة ويضع لها إعجاب وعدم إعجاب ، في جو تفاعلي نشط .

وكذلك من مميزات التطبيق  الرائعة :
* بطريقة برمجية إبداعية : يمكنك من خلال التطبيق  إرسال أي تدبر  :  على شكل لوحة جرافيك رائعة ، تختار خلفيتها من صور جميله ادرجناها في التطبيق  ، والأجمل أنك  تستطيع ان تختار الخلفية  من ألبوم الصور في جوالك أو تلتقطها بكاميرا الجوال مباشرة .
* وكذلك جمعنا أكثر من 2500 لوحة جرافيك تدبريه جميله تجدها مدرجه في كل آية تخصها .
* حرصا منا على نشر العلم : تستطيع تصدير وقفات آية أو سورة على شكل ملف pdf  أو ملف word او تستعرضها بشكل مرتب في المتصفح . ( حد أقصى ١٠ آيات لملفات pdf ، وعدد لا محدود للبقية )
* بإمكانك -تصفح وقفات أي عالم او شيخ او متدبر ، وذلك بالضغط مطولا على إسم صاحب الوقفة  ، كما يمكنك متابعة جديده ، عندما تقوم بتفضيله في قائمة المصادر المفضلة .
* ميزة البحث في الوقفات .
* ميزة تفضيل وقفة معينة  لكي ترجع لها لاحقا.
*  ٢٧ كتاب لتفسير القرآن الكريم ، بالإضافة لروابط مباشرة لتفسير الدرر السنية الرائع .
* مميزات أخرى  : مثل الورد اليومي - الوضع الليلي - تغيير ألوان الخط والخلفية - إضافة ملاحظة للآية - وضع علامة للرجوع للصفحة - تكبير خط الوقفات وتصغيره ، وغيرها من المميزات الرائعة .
ولدعم التطبيق أنشأنا قناة في اليوتيوب قمنا فيها بمونتاج أكثر من ٢٢٠٠ مقطع في التفسير والتدبر .

سألين الله ان يجعل هذا التطبيق معين للناس على تدارس القران وتدبره  وأن يشملنا جميعا قول  الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم ( مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ ) .

bluejetty:00131271:ios.name: Syllatiles - Word Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00131271:ios.summary: Looking for a cool mobile game that's both captivating and immersive? Look no further than Syllatiles - the ultimate word puzzle game that challenges you to first decipher a word, then locate its various parts and assemble them in the corre
bluejetty:00131271:ios.description:
Looking for a cool mobile game that's both captivating and immersive? Look no further than Syllatiles - the ultimate word puzzle game that challenges you to first decipher a word, then locate its various parts and assemble them in the correct order.
 With a multitude of levels and mind-bending riddles to solve, Syllatiles promises endless hours of entertainment and mental stimulation. Whether you're at home, outdoors, on the road, or on vacation, this game is the perfect way to pass the time while also enhancing your cognitive skills.
 Don't worry if you're a beginner - Syllatiles is designed to be accessible to players of all levels. Our puzzles are crafted with diversity in mind, and we even provide helpful hints and clues to assist you along the way.
 One of the unique features of Syllatiles is the way in which it forces players to think creatively and use their problem-solving skills. By piecing together fragmented words, you'll be able to stretch your brain in ways you never thought possible. You'll also learn new words and phrases along the way, expanding your vocabulary and making you a better communicator in the process.
 But Syllatiles isn't just about learning and mental agility - it's also incredibly fun! You'll feel a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment every time you solve a puzzle and progress to the next level. And with new challenges and riddles constantly being added to the game, you'll never run out of new obstacles to overcome.
 Rules of the game: 
Guess the mystery word
Find its parts on the game field
Assemble the word
Discover if you have correctly solved the puzzle
 So what are you waiting for? Download Syllatiles today and start experiencing the thrill of the ultimate word puzzle game. With its endless possibilities for entertainment and intellectual growth, you won't regret it!

bluejetty:00144869:ios.summary: Ready to go from slumdog to billionaire? Now you can say i am rich man! Take control of your destiny in our ultimate idle guy life simulator where you build your empire from the ground up! Live the dream of transforming from a poor guy into
bluejetty:00144869:ios.description:
Ready to go from slumdog to billionaire? Now you can say i am rich man! Take control of your destiny in our ultimate idle guy life simulator where you build your empire from the ground up! Live the dream of transforming from a poor guy into a powerful tycoon in this poor to rich game. Make strategic decisions, smart investments, and enjoy the thrill of climbing the ladder to wealth.
Live the life of luxury and success as you grow from nothing to a business mogul in this exciting idle billionaire tycoon game. Forget about repetitive clicking – let the game’s auto clicker take care of the small tasks while you focus on managing your empire.
Key Features: 
Start your empire from humble beginnings and expand to own multinational corporations in this thrilling rich simulator.
Recruit top-tier managers to optimize your operations and increase profits, allowing you to grow even faster.
Dominate your market by acquiring competitors and expanding your reach to new cities.
Explore global cities to unlock new opportunities and expand your wealth in the idle life sim game.
Negotiate the best deals and maximize your earnings with clever tactics.
Compete in events and challenges to earn rare rewards that push your business forward.
Embark on a journey of success, making crucial decisions that will determine your rise from nothing to a world-class tycoon. Watch your empire flourish and feel the satisfaction of becoming a respected rich man in the games world.
Slumdog Billionaire: combines strategy, excitement, and fulfillment in a perfect blend of idle life sim gameplay. The auto clicker feature makes it easy to grow your empire without the grind, and the offline functionality ensures you can keep progressing even when you’re not actively playing. Whether you’re a fan of get rich games or love tycoon simulations, this game offers endless fun and an emotional journey towards becoming a self-made billionaire.
Are you ready to live the billionaire lifestyle? Start your adventure today in this poor to rich game, tap your way to success, and become the richest man in the world in our game.

Discover Brainwaves, an immersive collection of binaural beats, brainwave frequencies, Solfeggio sounds, isochronic tones and ambient soundscapes for focus, sleep, study, meditation and relaxation.

Whether you're studying, working, meditating, relaxing or winding down before sleep, find a sound that fits your routine.

Explore binaural beats across different brainwave frequency ranges. Binaural beats use slightly different tones in each ear to create an immersive listening experience. Headphones are recommended.
Choose sounds for:
• Deep focus and concentration
• Study and productive work
• Sleep and nighttime relaxation
• Meditation and mindfulness
• Calm and quiet moments
--- BRAINWAVE FREQUENCIES ---
Explore different brainwave frequency ranges:
• Delta – Slow-frequency sounds for nighttime listening and relaxation
• Theta – Gentle sounds for meditation, mindfulness and quiet moments
• Alpha – Calming frequencies for relaxed focus
• Beta – Brainwave sounds for concentration and attentive listening
• Gamma – Fast-frequency sounds for focus and deep work
--- 40 HZ GAMMA & DEEP FOCUS ---
Explore dedicated 40 Hz Gamma sessions for focused listening while studying, reading, working or completing creative tasks.
Discover 40 Hz alongside Alpha, Beta and other brainwave sounds to create your preferred listening environment.
--- SLEEP & RELAXATION ---
Create a peaceful nighttime routine with binaural beats, Delta and Theta waves, ambient sounds and calming nature soundscapes.
Find relaxing audio for sleep routines, meditation, mindfulness and quiet moments when you're ready to unwind.
--- SOLFEGGIO FREQUENCIES ---
Explore a collection of Solfeggio and frequency-based sounds, including:
• 174 Hz
• 285 Hz
• 396 Hz
• 417 Hz
• 432 Hz
• 528 Hz
• 639 Hz
• 741 Hz
• 852 Hz
• 963 Hz
Discover different frequencies for meditation, relaxation, mindfulness and peaceful listening.
--- ISOCHRONIC TONES & AMBIENT SOUNDS ---
Explore isochronic tones, ambient music, nature sounds and frequency-based soundscapes for even more ways to personalize your listening experience.
--- FEATURES ---
• Binaural beats for focus, sleep, study and meditation
• Alpha, Beta, Theta, Delta and Gamma brainwave sounds
• Dedicated 40 Hz Gamma sessions
• Solfeggio frequencies
• 432 Hz and 528 Hz sounds
• Isochronic tones
• Ambient music and nature sounds
• Simple and intuitive playback controls
• Growing library of brainwave and frequency content
FIND YOUR FREQUENCY
From binaural beats and 40 Hz Gamma to Alpha, Theta and Delta waves, Solfeggio frequencies and isochronic tones, Brainwaves brings frequency-based sounds together in one place.
Choose your sound and create a listening routine for focus, study, sleep, meditation or relaxation.
--- SUBSCRIPTION ---
• Monthly, Yearly and Lifetime plans are available.
• Unlock access to premium frequencies, soundscapes and sound features.

--- DISCLAIMER ---
Brainwaves provides audio content for general wellness, relaxation, meditation and entertainment purposes only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Individual experiences may vary.

bluejetty:00089669:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00089669:ios.description:
The fastest way to plan your shopping — with real product pictures, instant autocomplete, and a list that organizes itself. 
Grocery Buddy is built for busy households who want to stop making lists from scratch, stop forgetting things, and stop second-guessing which brand they meant.
SEE WHAT YOU'RE BUYING
Every item on your list comes with a real product picture. No more squinting at "pasta sauce" and wondering if you meant the green jar or the red one. Pictures help you and your family grab the right thing at the store — even when someone else is doing the shopping.
• Real photos for millions of grocery items
• Recognize brands at a glance
• Perfect when a partner or kid is running errands for you
• Fewer "is this the one?" text messages from the aisle
FAST AS A TAP
Type one letter and Grocery Buddy already knows what you mean. Your staples show up before you finish typing — milk, eggs, bread, your kid's favorite snack bar — because we remember what you actually buy.
• Instant autocomplete from a single keystroke
• Smart suggestions based on your real shopping history
• One-tap add for household favorites
• Build a full week's list in under a minute
ORGANIZED AUTOMATICALLY
No more walking back and forth across the store. Grocery Buddy sorts your list by aisle — produce, dairy, pantry, frozen — so you shop in the order you actually walk. Categories adjust as you add items. No set up required.
• Auto-sorted by store section
• Frequently bought items surface first
• Repeat and forgotten items get flagged before you leave
• Works for any store layout
SHARED LISTS FOR THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD
Add your partner, your roommate, your kids, your parents. Everyone sees the same list in real time. When someone adds "out of coffee" at home, whoever's at the store sees it before they hit the checkout. No more double-buying. No more forgotten items because the text got lost.
• Real-time sync across every family member's phone
• Everyone can add, check off, and edit
• Great for roommates, extended family, and co-parenting households
• One list, one trip, no crossed wires
KEEPS YOUR FAVORITES IN ONE PLACE
Your regulars are always ready. The olive oil you like. The specific yogurt brand. The snacks the kids actually eat. Tap once to add them to this week's list — no typing, no hunting.
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE GROCERY BUDDY
• Rated 4.7 stars by over 750 shoppers
• Built for real weekly shopping, not abstract productivity
• No clutter, no bloated features, no ads interrupting your list
• Free — with no paid tier, no subscription, no upsell
PERFECT FOR
• Parents juggling a weekly family shop
• Couples splitting grocery runs
• Roommates sharing a household list
• Anyone tired of scribbled notes, lost texts, and forgotten items
100% FREE
• Every feature included — no paid tier
• No subscription, ever
• No locked features
• No ads interrupting your list

bluejetty:00040517:ios.name: Gusto TV
bluejetty:00040517:ios.summary: Welcome to the Gusto TV App! Gusto TV is the world's best food channel. From baking to barbeque to food culture and sustainability, our award-winning programming celebrates culture, diversity, and family in fun and innovative ways. Our show
bluejetty:00040517:ios.description:
Welcome to the Gusto TV App! Gusto TV is the world's best food channel. From baking to barbeque to food culture and sustainability, our award-winning programming celebrates culture, diversity, and family in fun and innovative ways. Our shows will make your mouth water and your tummy rumble. Food is the one true global language and Gusto TV speaks all dialects. Come eat the world with us!
FEATURED GUSTO TV SHOWS
Bonacini’s Italy: Italian cuisine is so much more than pizza and pasta – but there’s still lots of tasty pasta in Bonacini's Italy. Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini cooks his way through 15 Italian regions, exploring the flavors and ingredients that make these areas unique.
Cook Like A Chef: Cook Like a Chef focuses on how to cook as opposed to what to cook. Featuring a group of innovative, talented young chefs, watch as they explore and explain the arcana of cooking techniques. Each episode centers on a single ingredient or theme, as prepared by an expert chef who shares tips, tricks, and cooking techniques.
Let’s Brunch: Let’s Brunch is a delightful cooking series dedicated to everyone’s favorite leisurely and decadent mid-morning meal. Hosted by Vanessa Gianfrancesco, Let’s Brunch showcases sweet and savory recipes, along with the occasional refreshing beverage or cozy latte.
Flour Power: Flour Power is a fun, stylish, and playful series that is all about sharing the love and joy of baking. Step back in time with our lovely host Jessica McGovern in her retro inspired kitchen. Celebrating an uncomplicated love of baking, Flour Power shows us that baking doesn’t have to be perfect or complex – you can mess up and it can still turn out great. Join Jessica and indulge in the whimsical dream of Flour Power, it will be the sweetest half-hour of your day!
One World Kitchen: One World Kitchen is a creative and high style cooking series featuring nine cuisines: Argentinian, Italian, Thai, Japanese, Indian, Lebanese, Vietnamese, Cantonese, and Greek. The young and vibrant hosts will captivate your audience by teaching them how to master the world’s hottest dishes and showing them age-old cooking secrets from their unique cultures.
Spencer’s BIG 30: Spencer’s BIG 30 is a fast-paced series featuring healthy, hearty meals for four that can be made by anyone in around 30 minutes, for around 30 dollars. Keeping the pace, while guiding us from prep to plate, Chef Spencer Watts gives his top tips and tricks for cutting down cooking time, without sacrificing flavor. To prove how efficient his meals are, he actually cooks the entire meal in one take and it’s always around 30 minutes. That’s right - no television tricks in this series! While the kitchen may get a little messy, Spencer’s process is natural, fun, and easy to follow.
The Wizard of Sauce: The Wizard of Sauce pulls back the curtain on the magical world of sauces. In each episode, Chef Kyle Crawford demystifies the often-intimidating methods of sauce preparation creating three recipes based on different sauce techniques. Each episode presents history, health, and kitchen tips related to the recipes and ingredients through three secondary AI-enabled character segments – played by Kyle himself. The Wizard of Sauce shows audiences that anyone can be a wizard in the kitchen!
VegHeadz: Dive into a world of unique and exciting veg-forward dishes with VegHeadz! Hosted by Chef Pino Di Cerbo, this captivating series takes veggies from side dish to center stage. VegHeadz focuses on making cooking with a variety of vegetables fun, unintimidating and surprising in the best way. With fun facts about plant-based diets and a ‘grain of the day’, get ready to uncover a whole new world of cuisine never thought possible!
 AND MANY MORE!

bluejetty:00066158:ios.description:
Dive in this NEW exciting game with a cute little newborn baby to grow up.
To make this possible, your warm care will be needed all the time. 
A baby will grow up in front of your eyes, and you will become a caring parent. All you need to do is give love, and you shall receive one.
At the beginning you will have to take care for a baby in a basket till his 6th month. After that the baby will grow, and it will leave his comfort basket, and it will go on a soft, warm and cozy carpet. 
Amazing new feature will be unlocked when baby grow old to 6th month. The feature is called – Face Detection.
What does the Face Detection do?
It’s similar to Animated Emojis. Using the front camera of your smartphone, the Face detection will analyze your face, and it will your baby’s face with your own face. And now the baby will be doing the same head movements you do. Super fun, and It’s real time. The baby will look like you.
As you continue to grow up your baby, the game will unlock new amazing features such as, football, basketball and many more other funny things to do. The baby game will also give you the full freedom to furnish the baby room, you will be able to change the room as you wish. You can change the baby’s clothes, the name of the baby, his gender, skin color and many, many more other things.
Dive into this super adventure game, and have fun.
For recommendations, and new features please contact us by email.

bluejetty:00082047:ios.name: Somfy myLink
bluejetty:00082047:ios.summary:
Control your Radio Technology Somfy® (RTS) motorized products wherever you are!
The Somfy myLink™ app provides simplified control of RTS motorized blinds, shades, draperies, awnings, rolling shutters and screens from the convenience of you
bluejetty:00082047:ios.description:
Control your Radio Technology Somfy® (RTS) motorized products wherever you are!
The Somfy myLink™ app provides simplified control of RTS motorized blinds, shades, draperies, awnings, rolling shutters and screens from the convenience of your iOS device for convenient sunlight management anytime, anywhere. With the Somfy myLink app, you can:
- Control up to 16 channels of RTS motorized products per myLink WiFi to RTS Interface
- Create Scenes for easy control of multiple motorized products 
- Link with Amazon Alexa for convenient voice control 
- Create Schedules to automatically activate your motorized products at a certain time of day, day of the week, or by sunrise and sunset
- Add more myLink WiFi to RTS Interfaces for multiple zone control 
- Control your RTS motorized products both at home and away
- Easily share access with other users
- Integration of RTS products with Crestron, Control4 and Savant control systems 
- Demo mode: includes an integrated demo mode for users to experience the app before purchasing the myLink interface
- iPad view includes drag & drop scene and schedule creation, quick access toolbar and dashboard-style home screen
- English, French and Spanish language 
The Somfy myLink app requires at least one Somfy myLink WiFi to RTS Interface and existing RTS motorized product(s) with at least one programmed RTS hand-held, in-wall or table top control.

DIG DEEPER. STREAM FAIRER.
Carbon is redefining electronic music streaming — fair, transparent, built for artists and fans.
Discover new sounds, empower creators, and be part of a movement that values music differently.
Discover the future of music streaming with Carbon, your free gateway to underground electronic music. Whether you're a vinyl collector, a track digger, a fan of top electronic music labels, or simply an electronic music lover, Carbon is designed for you. Join a global community of music enthusiasts and immerse yourself in high-definition sound and a seamless user experience.
Carbon offers a free curated artist lineup with tracks from renowned underground electronic music artists. We partner with top music labels to bring you the freshest beats and hidden gems. Discover and start streaming emerging artists reshaping the underground electronic music scene.

Join Carbon today and transform your music streaming experience. Download now for free and immerse yourself in the world of underground electronic music. Start streaming the best in underground electronic music and support your favorite artists with Carbon.

bluejetty:00021626:ios.description:
股海茫茫不知如何選股票? 抓不到股票買賣時機? 不用再盲從股市明牌，三竹智選股讓您智慧選股、自信持股，輕鬆找到自己的台股獲利模組。
盤前盤中盤後一次解決您所有投資難題，搭配動態教學步步到位。
◎盤前選股：百種選股策略回測，巴菲特、彼得林區等大師選股推薦，提高選股勝率與投報率
◎盤中進出：即時觀察K線與市場資金流向、主力籌碼動態，隨時掌握壓力支撐買賣點位
◎盤後健檢：搭配三竹專利個股健檢X區間估值，理性檢驗手中持股實際價值
一、專利健檢個股優劣X同步三竹股市自選股
◎同步三竹股市，輕鬆健檢自選股
登入三竹股市帳號即可輕鬆同步自選股，為您所有追蹤的股票一一健檢。
◎五角度類股評分圖
預設五個「價值」「技術」「籌碼」「成長」「定存」五項指標雷達分析，協助投資人對個股做全盤了解，並能自訂指標做個人化股票評比。
◎六宮格多空診斷表
專利六宮格診斷圖提供財務、籌碼、技術三大簡表，股票特性、優劣一目瞭然，多空判斷標籤還能點擊查詢詳細資訊，新手老手皆受用無窮。
◎市場區間估值
多元的區間估值比較方法，並可納入同類股票群組群比，加入自訂合理區間範圍，讓你算出每檔股票合理價。
◎個股摘要與比較表
可對比多檔個股走勢，透過籌碼面、基本面表現以及數據圖表精準掌握個股位階。
二、市場關注與趨勢
◎分析計算出最完整的歷史資訊，讓你透過漲跌幅與成交金額輕鬆篩選市場觀察動向與投資者關注標的。
◎股神藏在民間，精選PTT股市版熱門文章，即時掌握社群風向。
三、策略回測排名
◎透過週期回測分析各選股策略，可依投報率、勝率等回饋排名，即時更新策略選股歷史效益，精選符合策略的股票，是您縱橫股海的最強股票投資軟體!
四、掌握分點籌碼進出、專注看盤模式
◎全新推出專注看盤模式，只顯示最重要的盤中資訊，精準掌握進出點位。
五、個人筆記備忘錄X技術分析畫線輔助
◎技術分析畫線輔助：輕鬆上手的手繪線圖，可以幫助你紀錄長期支撐與壓力，盤後歷史判斷進場時機。
◎個人筆記備忘錄：可就單一個股紀錄每日操作筆記與看盤心得。
六、投資風格性向測驗X新手友善學習
◎最友善新手的看盤軟體：市場首創的投資風格性向測驗，依照您的屬性選擇適合您的投資策略，APP內有股市看盤動態教學，讓您第一次投資就上手！
七、打造您專屬的看盤介面
◎靈活卡片式看盤介面：自由編排看盤順序，依照自己的看盤習慣量身訂作，投資更得心應手。
◎多樣看盤色系搭配：您可從介面設定選擇護眼深色或清晰淺色模式，打造您喜愛的風格介面。
八、個股警示通知系統
◎針對個股類別條件即時價量(單量、漲跌幅)、行情資訊、關鍵價位可設定高達36種條件提醒，關掉APP也能通知您，不再錯失黃金時機。
九、股市即時討論聊天室
◎飆股一起飛，公園一起睡，歡迎來到智選股即時聊天室，人人都是股市大富翁。
--

bluejetty:00132317:ios.name: SynthMaster One
bluejetty:00132317:ios.summary: SynthMaster One iOS is KV331 Audio's first full blown universal synth app on iOS platform. It's a powerful wavetable synth with an intuitive workflow. With its simple layout, rich wavetable/waveform content and inspiring factory presets lib
bluejetty:00132317:ios.description:
SynthMaster One iOS is KV331 Audio's first full blown universal synth app on iOS platform. It's a powerful wavetable synth with an intuitive workflow. With its simple layout, rich wavetable/waveform content and inspiring factory presets library, designing new sounds with SynthMaster One iOS is a joy.
SynthMaster One iOS is feature wise identical to the desktop version except the following:
* 16 voice polyphony (32 for the desktop version)
* Comes with 650 presets (1250 for the desktop version)
FEATURES
* Universal App: SynthMaster One is now a universal standalone/AUv3 synth app running on iPhone 7 and above.
* 650 Factory Presets: SynthMaster One iOS comes with inspiring factory presets from a world class team of sound designers: Arksun, Aiyn Zahev, BigTone Studios, Brian Transeau, Bluffmunkey, Bulent Biyikoglu, Gercek Dorman, Dejavu Sound, Fragment Audio, Kurt Ader, Mirko Ruta, Nori Ubukata, Rob Lee, Ufuk Kevser, Selcuk Ergen, The Machine, Vandalism Sound, Venus Theory, Vorpalsound and Xenos Soundworks
* AUv3: SynthMaster One iOS supports AudioUnits V3, allowing multiple instances to run under supporting DAW apps like GarageBand, Cubasis or Beat Maker. 
* Files App Integration: Easily import/export presets, waveforms or scales using the common file browser UI (requires iOS 11+).
* Real-time Modulation Feedback: See in real-time how modulation sources and targets change. This is a very helpful feature when designing sounds!
* Cross Platform Cloud Synchronization: Easily synchronize your SynthMaster One related data across multiple platforms (Windows, MacOS, iPad, iPhone)
* Semi-Modular Architecture: For each SynthMaster One instance, there are 2 oscillators with 2 sub oscillators, 2 Filters, 4 ADSR Envelopes, 3 LFOs, a powerful 16 step arpeggiator/sequencer and also 11 different effects that can be inserted on to 6 FX insert slots. The sub oscillators can be connected to the oscillators in 5 different modes which let you use it as a regular sub oscillator or do complex modulations such as ring modulation, amplitude modulation, phase modulation or frequency modulation.
* 32 Step Arpeggiator/Sequencer: The arpeggiator in SynthMaster One features classic arpeggiator modes such as Up, Down, UpDown, DownUp, UpDown2, DownUp2, AsPlayed as well as Sequence, Chord and Arpeggiate modes. 
* Wavetable Synthesis: SynthMaster One implements true wavetable synthesis which opens up new possibilities for sound design. It comes with a rich content library with hundreds of waveforms and wavetables.
* Stereo Oscillators with up to 16 voices Unison: Each of the 2 oscillators in SynthMaster One have stereo output, and can have up to 16 voices "unison". Using the "voices", "voices mix", "detune curve", "detune spread", "pan stread", "tone spread" and "phase spread" parameters, each oscillator can generate a rich "supersaw" type sound.
* Zero Delay Feedback Filters: All of the 4 filter categories in SynthMaster One are developed using the zero delay feedback filter technology. With advanced filter parameters like input gain, drive, acid, filter nonlinearities and up to 4 times oversampling you can get that "analog" sound from the filters!
* Rich Set of Effects: SynthMaster One features 11 different effect types: Distortion, LoFi, Ensemble, Phaser, 6 Band EQ, Compressor, Vocoder, Delay, Chorus, Tremolo, Reverb.
* Microtuning: SynthMaster One supports Scala tuning, so tuning can be set either for each preset or globally by loading from a Scala tuning file. SynthMaster One comes with 300+ scales ranging from 5 note equal tempered scales to 12 note alternate tuning scales.
* Preset Browser: SynthMaster One features a comprehensive preset browser with separate search criterias for instrument type, preset attributes, music style or preset author.
SUPPORTS
* All 64-bit iPad devices
* AUv3 Audio Unit Extensions
* Note-per-channel MIDI controllers (MPE)
* Ableton Link
* Bluetooth LE MIDI Controllers
* AirDrop

bluejetty:00132185:ios.description:
Bitdefender Central places your local and network cybersecurity at your fingertips. Use it to control security for all your Bitdefender-protected devices, and to set up and manage Bitdefender BOX, the revolutionary smart home hub that secures your entire Wi-Fi network.
LOCAL PROTECTION
With Bitdefender Central you can:
- Install Bitdefender protection on all your devices
- Manage security and protect your kids online
- Scan, clean and optimize any device remotely
- Get instant notification whenever Bitdefender detects a threat
- Quickly access your activity dashboard
- Receive security updates for your devices 24/7
NETWORK PROTECTION
Bitdefender Central works with BOX to secure and manage your smart home:
- Get ironclad protection for all your internet-connected devices, at home and on the go
- Manage all devices in your home network from a single mobile app
- Protect your kids online and manage screen time with parental controls 
- Set up your Bitdefender BOX
- Discover your devices and group them under your Bitdefender BOX network 
- Check protection status and connectivity status for all your connected devices
- Filter your devices by status or by user
- Create profiles for your family members and allocate devices to them
- Get real-time notifications for threats blocked by BOX: anomaly detection, unencrypted - - Banking information sent, botnet attacks
- Change your Wi-Fi name and password
- Pause the internet connection on your devices
PARENTAL FEATURES
- Filter out inappropriate content and manage your child's internet time
- Choose from 3 preset and customizable filtering modes to effectively manage your child’s online activities
- Unified reporting and management across all devices
PRIVACY
- Locate your lost or stolen devices
- Send text or sound alerts to your devices
- Lock your lost or stolen devices to prevent unauthorized access
Privacy Policy:
https://www.bitdefender.com/site/view/legal-privacy-policy-for-home-users-solutions.html

Flight Simulator 2017 FlyWings is finally here! It contains many improvements and the flight physics are perfect!
Enjoy a huge set of aircraft - 95 - and almost every air company! This is definitely the best flight simulator ever developed for macOS!
Fly in more than +2000 missions, over +600 airports in 9 different cities around the world. Use our GPS tool to create your own routes.
The first flight simulation with all city’s buildings and houses, all the airports have fingers, terminal, hangar, and taxiway lines. Real light system on the runways, with PAPI lights and more!
The environment, scenario and 3D models are highly detailed, realistic air and ground traffic, change almost every simulation parameter, like visibility, temperature, turbulence, wind direction, all the weather conditions and hour of the flight. Fly in stormy weather, with lightings and heavy rain to test your skills!
All the aircraft included in the simulator have specific modifications and special features, you will be able to choose the best aircraft that fits your needs!
Aircraft features:
- Choose between airplanes, helicopters, jet fighters, aerobatic planes and more!
- Configure the model specification and family.
- Choose one of the dozens of airline companies to fly your plane.
- Configure fuel payload and weight.
- Control all flaps, trims, spoilers, gear and turn engines on or off.
- Very detailed 3D models of the planes.
- Turn all the light signals on or off (Strobe, Landing, Transponder etc).
- 9 different cameras.
- Autopilot with speed, altitude, vertical speed and heading. 
Scenario and environment features:
- +600 airports around the world
- All airports have taxiway lines
- All the cities have real buildings and houses
- All airports have landing and take off lights
- Audio settings
- New details
- Thousand+ miles in 9 cities:
 > New York
 > San Francisco
 > Chicago
 > Hawaii (enjoy the view of the volcanoes!)
 > Las Vegas
 > Los Angeles
 > Seattle
 > Washington D.C
 > Saint Martin
- Weather conditions and hour option to choose when to fly.

bluejetty:00083580:ios.description:
► ANOTHER FINE MESS… 
Dive straight into the action in this fun casual mining and farm game with a whole city to be built at a breakneck speed and only one jack-of-all-trades up to the job – you. Start small with a handful of modest houses and keep building until there’s a vast, sprawling metropolis and your own industrial empire in this relentlessly fast-moving adventure game that’s enormously addictive and easy to play. Download Town Mess now for non-stop entrepreneurial action in this crazy construction simulator that won’t give you a moment of peace.
► THE PACE OF PROGRESS
• From the sticks: Start out on a farm in the wood building log cabins, and in no time you’ll find yourself in the heart of a thriving modern city that you’ve constructed all by yourself. Well, almost…
• All this mines: Mine resources, build houses and collect rents. Then choose whether to invest your income in new facilities or upgrades (such as ones increasing your capacity) or to hire assistants to help with rapidly increasing workload.
• All the ages of man: From wood to steel, logs to cement and on into the future, Town Mess is a building simulator that takes you racing through human progress without pausing for breath. As you advance technologically, the pace of the game gets even more frantic. Build the future with your own two hands.
• Time for time management? To avoid logjams and keep the building logistics chain flowing, you’ll have to keep moving, with little time to stop and think. You’ll also have to strategize and use your time wisely to excel at the game, especially as the level gets higher and you’re required to keep an eye on numerous facilities and an increasing staff of assistants.
• Give people what they want: Helpful thought bubbles will show you exactly what your customers want, so hurry up and get building before they despair of ever getting a haircut, watching the latest movie or enjoying a juicy hamburger.
• More haste less speed: The game’s simple and intuitive controls mean you can dive straight into the action, but try to stay calm and coordinated – you don’t want to find yourself stuck behind a streetlamp or constantly bumping into your delivery truck.
► SEEK YOUR FORTUNE AT A TOP SPEED
If you love the idea of mining and farm games but find the pace of the most to be a little slow, then get ready for a whirlwind adventure built of wood, brick, steel and raw energy. Develop yourself from a humble woodsman into an industrial tycoon in the blink of an eye in this fun, cartoon-like city-building simulator that’s guaranteed to be a blast. Download Town Mess, roll up your sleeves and get to work right now!

bluejetty:00046435:ios.name: Zero Motorcycles NextGen
bluejetty:00046435:ios.summary: The Zero Motorcycles NextGen App version 2.13.0 offers essential integration for Zero Motorcycles FX, FXS, FXE, S, DS, DSR, DSR/X, SR, SR/F and SR/S. Offering integration for all your motorcycle’s performance data, customization, and experi
bluejetty:00046435:ios.description:
The Zero Motorcycles NextGen App version 2.13.0 offers essential integration for Zero Motorcycles FX, FXS, FXE, S, DS, DSR, DSR/X, SR, SR/F and SR/S. Offering integration for all your motorcycle’s performance data, customization, and experience into the palm of your hand. For select models you can customize your motorcycle’s performance, assemble your own dashboard, relive your rides, monitor your bike’s whereabouts and so much more with the Zero Motorcycles NextGen App.
NextGen 2.13.0 combines all the best features of both of Zero Motorcycles’ previous app offerings to date, with compatibility with the entire Zero Motorcycles range from 2013 forward.
App Features
Zero’s NextGen App works with the bike’s dash and Cypher II or Cypher III operating system to create a feature-rich ecosystem.  Common features for these models include:
* Select and create ride modes
* Personalized dash options
* Scheduled and target-based charging
* Charging station location assistance
* Extensive notifications, including state-of-charge (SOC), time-to-charge and last-ride statistics.
* Ride data: location, speed, lean angle, power, torque, SoC, energy used/re-generated
* Remote diagnostics and Cypher III updates
* Provides ownership data when connected to Cypher III motorcycles
* Model restrictions apply. Not all features will be available for FX, FXS, FXE, S, DS, DSR. Not all features will be available for SR prior to MY22.
The Connected Bike
MY20+ SR/F and SR/S and MY24+ S, SR, DS, DSR, DSR/X are connected through cellular networks, transmitting info to the App at all times. Ride information, current bike status and location are always available. This connectivity gives you the ability to monitor the bike in four (4) main areas: Bike Status & Alerts, Charging, Ride Data Sharing, and System Upgrades & Updates.

bluejetty:00123346:ios.description:
Compre em mercados, restaurantes, farmácias e pet shop de forma fácil e rápida, tudo a um toque de você. As ofertas dos melhores mercados e restaurantes da sua cidade estão no IFood. Aqui você também encontra produtos para seu pet além de comprar itens de farmácia.
Pensou em pedir comida? Peça no IFood! Ir ao mercado, farmácia ou pet shop? Esquece, vai de IFood!
Delivery de Restaurantes
Não importa se você quer comer sushi, comida vegetariana, hambúrguer, pizza ou experimentar um restaurante novo. Use o iFood e peça em vários restaurantes no melhor app de delivery de comida para sua fome e seu bolso, sem precisar esperar uma Black Friday
Delivery de Mercado
Bateu aquela vontade de preparar sua comida em casa ou faltou algum item da compra do mês? Você pode aproveitar nosso delivery de mercado para comprar os ingredientes que faltam e receber na sua casa!
Delivery de Bebidas
Que tal umas bebidas pra curtir com os amigos no fim de semana? Com o iFood você recebe as bebidas em casa e ainda economiza com cupons de desconto e ofertas.
Delivery de Farmácia
Precisa comprar remédios, fraldas, produtos de higiene, produtos de beleza ou algum outro item de farmácia? É só pedir pelo iFood! Compre remédios, produtos de beleza e outros itens de farmácia com cupons de oferta e descontos disponíveis nas farmácias mais perto de você.
Delivery de Pet Shop
Acabou a ração do seu pet? Precisa de areia pra sua gatinha? Não tem problema! Com o iFood você pode pedir ração, areia de gato, remédios veterinários e outros itens de pet com cupons de desconto e ofertas nos pet shops perto da sua casa.
Cupons e descontos pra vc
Com o iFood você sempre tem opção de mercado, restaurante, farmácia e pet shop pra comprar com qualidade gastando pouco sempre, não só na Black Friday. Confira os vários cupons disponíveis pra você e aproveite os descontos em restaurantes, supermercados, farmácia e pet shop com entrega grátis pra pedir a qualquer hora do dia.
Milhares de opções baratinhas
Use nossa busca ou navegue pelas categorias e listas especiais pra encontrar as ofertas de comida nos melhores restaurantes, promoções de bebida, pizzaria, farmácia, pet shop ou compra de mercado. Depois, é só colocar na sacola e fechar seu pedido online. Em pouco tempo, o entregador estará na sua porta com tudo o que pediu do restaurante ou supermercado.
Acompanhe seu pedido
No iFood você recebe sua entrega de comida e mercado rapidinho e ainda pode acompanhar as etapas de preparação do pedido e entrega pelo app. Aproveite para fazer suas compras de mercado, experimentar um restaurante novo ou agendar sua comida e receber em casa.
Baixe o app de delivery que traz para pertinho de você os seus pratos favoritos, ou se decidir cozinhar, você encontra todos os ingredientes de sua receita em alguns poucos toques em supermercados. Com nosso delivery, você pede pratos dos melhores restaurantes, supermercados, farmácias e pet shop!
Tá esperando o que pra baixar nosso app de delivery de comida, mercado, farmácia e pet shop? Tenha os melhores supermercados e restaurantes, aquela pizzaria do bairro ou o mercado em que você sempre compra a apenas alguns cliques de distância. Aproveite para fazer seu pedido de comida e bebida e pedir sua entrega onde estiver. Tenha pizza, hambúrguer, comida vegetariana, sushi, fast food, comida italiana e muitos outros pratos do seu restaurante ou supermercado favorito na sua casa.
Veja a lista completa das cidades onde tem entrega do iFood. Peça agora seu delivery de comida e mercado online: https://www.ifood.com.br/cidades-atendidas

bluejetty:00098466:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00098466:ios.description:
The #1 camera app for field professionals - with over 4 million downloads. Conota Camera captures photos and adds GPS coordinates, timestamps, project names, and notes in one step, so you can focus on your work instead of your paperwork.
Conota - GPS Camera & Timestamp Camera makes capturing pictures and taking notes more efficiently, combining both processes in one single app.
There is no need to take notes on a piece of paper while taking pictures. Conota will add your inserted notes automatically both to the picture and to the file name. This will give you more time to concentrate on your work, while Conota will take care of saving your notes and pictures combined in a lossless format onto your phone.
Conota works, so you can work!
With Conota - GPS Camera & Timestamp Camera, you can add a project name, company name, notes and more information, for example a reference no. or chainage directly in the app while taking pictures.
Additional relevant data for professionals, e.g. GPS coordinates / photo location (latitude and longitude and multiple other coordinate formats), GPS accuracy, altitude, address, date and time (timestamp) will be added by Conota.
Information that can be added:
- Project name
- Taken notes
- GPS coordinates / photo location (latitude and longitude & more)
- GPS accuracy (in m or ft)
- Altitude (in m or ft)
- Date & time (timestamp)
- Address
- Compass direction
- Customized company logo
- Reference No. / Chainage
Conota - GPS Camera & Timestamp Camera supports the following coordinate/grid systems:
- WGS84 (latitude and longitude)
- UTM
- MGRS (NAD83)
- USNG (NAD83)
- State Plane Coordinate System (NAD83 - sft)
- State Plane Coordinate System (NAD83 - ift)
- ETRS89
- ED50
- British National Grid (OS National Grid)
- Map Grid of Australia (MGA2020)
- RD (RDNAPTRANS2018)
- Irish Grid
- Swiss Grid CH1903+ / LV95
- New Zealand Transverse Mercator 2000 (NZTM2000)
- Gauß-Krüger (MGI)
- Bundesmeldenetz (MGI)
- Gauß-Krüger (Germany)
- SWEREF99 TM
- MAGNA-SIRGAS / Origen-Nacional
- SIRGAS 2000
- CTRM05 / CR05
- PRS92
- PT-TM06 / ETRS89
- STEREO70 / Pulkovo 1942(58)
- HTRS96 / TM
Conota - GPS Camera & Timestamp Camera is used by land surveyors, civil engineers, construction managers, architects, geologists, real estate agents, and other professionals world-wide. Become one of them!
By using our app, you accept our Terms of Use. For information on how we handle your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/conota-terms
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/conota-privacy

bluejetty:00073904:ios.name: Lumos: Sun and Moon Tracker
bluejetty:00073904:ios.summary: Intuitive yet powerful, Lumos accurately predicts the position of the sun and moon at any time, on any day, in any place. Whether you’re planning a photo shoot, a wedding, or a solar panel installation, tracking the sun and moon has never b
bluejetty:00073904:ios.description:
Intuitive yet powerful, Lumos accurately predicts the position of the sun and moon at any time, on any day, in any place. Whether you’re planning a photo shoot, a wedding, or a solar panel installation, tracking the sun and moon has never been easier!
Lumos is divided into six main modules:
• The augmented reality view harnesses the power of AR to visually project past, present, or future sun and moon positions (and moon phases!) onto your surroundings, letting you perfectly visualize your plans.
• The map view overlays the sun and moon positions for a given time and location onto a map of that location, letting you make plans from afar.
• The Street View mode works like the AR view, but it takes advantage of Google Street View to allow you to envision sun and moon positions for remote locations (requires Lumos Pro).
• The calendar view displays a simple list of rise/set times and moon phases throughout the year, letting you see the big picture at a glance. Tap a row to see the detailed ephemeris for that day.
• The notifications module lets you sign up to receive notifications for significant solar and lunar events, including: astronomical, nautical, and civil dawn/dusk, blue hour, golden hour, sunrise/set, solar noon, moon rise/set, lunar transit, and lunar perigee/apogee (requires Lumos Pro).
• The shadow length view calculates the exact length of the shadow an object will cast on a given time and day, letting you see the result both visually and numerically. You can also calculate the height of an object if you know the length of its shadow.
With an affordable one-time purchase of Lumos Pro, you can also:
• Search for a location by name or manually enter coordinates
• Save locations for later reference or offline use*
• Take notes on a saved location and have them readily available the next time you view it
*The map view and Street View do not currently support offline use
NOTE: The sun and moon positions calculated by Lumos are accurate to within a small fraction of a degree. However, as with any augmented-reality app, the accuracy of the projection is dependent on the underlying hardware. If you are seeing inaccurate positions, please calibrate your device's compass and ensure that you are not near any sources of electromagnetic interference (e.g. microwaves, computers, car engines, high voltage lines). Phone cases containing batteries are known to cause compass interference. You can also use the visual calibration tool to align the projection with sun’s current position. Please feel free to contact us if you continue to have issues.
_____________
Terms of Use: https://luminouslabs.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://luminouslabs.co/privacy

bluejetty:00034134:ios.description:
The ultimate map for EV drivers — find ULTRA FAST charging stations around the world.
Whether you drive a Tesla, BYD, Hyundai, Ford, Volkswagen, Rivian, 
Kia or any other electric vehicle, this app helps you discover and 
navigate to the nearest fast charging stations on your route, 
anywhere in the world.
# Features
- Worldwide charging map: View thousands of fast charging stations from 
major networks — including Tesla Supercharger, BYD, Ionity and many 
more — on a single interactive map.
- Detailed station info: Check charging power, number of stalls, 
opening hours, network operator, plug types and vehicle compatibility.
- Smart filters: Filter stations by network, charging speed, plug type, 
or accessibility — including Tesla Superchargers equipped with Magic 
Dock or NACS connectors that are open to non-Tesla vehicles.
- Precise locations: Get exact addresses and GPS coordinates to plan 
your trips without hassle.
- Journey planner: Plan a route between two points and find every 
fast charger along the way.
- Send to your vehicle: Transfer a station's location directly to your 
Tesla's in-vehicle navigation, or open it in Apple Maps, Google Maps 
or Waze for quick navigation.
- Real-time updates: Stay informed about new stations and updates to 
existing ones, worldwide.
Never waste time searching for a charging station again. Download 
the app and hit the road with peace of mind!
# Disclaimer
This is an independent application. It is not affiliated with, 
authorized by, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with 
Tesla, Inc., BYD Company Ltd., or any other charging network operator 
or vehicle manufacturer referenced in the app. All trademarks and 
brand names mentioned — including but not limited to "Tesla", 
"Supercharger", "BYD", "Ionity", "Fastned", "ChargePoint", 
"Electrify America", "EVgo", "Allego" — are the property of their 
respective owners and are used here for informational and 
identification purposes only (nominative use). We do not claim 
any rights in third-party trademarks.
# Subscription
For the Pro subscription, subscriptions will be billed monthly or 
annually for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current 
period. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at 
least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions 
can be managed by the user and automatic renewal can be turned off 
by accessing the user's account settings after purchase. Any unused 
portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when 
the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where 
applicable. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation 
of purchase.
Terms of Use: https://warthoglab.com/terms/superchargers
Privacy: https://warthoglab.com/privacy/superchargers
