bluejetty:00100701:ios.description:
Join 15+ million Muslims strengthening their relationship with the Quran.
Tarteel is the leading AI-powered Quran companion designed to help you memorize, read, and review with confidence. Whether you are a student of Hifz or someone looking to improve their daily recitation, Tarteel adapts to your journey.
THE #1 AI QURAN COMPANION
Simply hide the verses and recite; Tarteel uses industry-leading recognition accuracy to track your voice and reveal the words on the screen as you recite them. It’s not just about reading—it’s about verifying your memorization instantly.
REINFORCE YOUR MEMORIZATION
• Memorization Mistake Detection: Hide the verses on the mushaf and recite from memory. Tarteel’s AI listens to your recitation and flags word-level errors, skipped words, or incorrect tashkeel instantly.
• Recite Anywhere, Anytime: Whether you are in the car, walking to work, or whispering in a quiet room, Tarteel follows your recitation. No need to wait for a revision partner. Your Quran companion is always ready.
• Live Correction: Tap on any highlighted mistake to see exactly what you recited versus the correct Ayah. Build confidence before your next class.
PLAN, TRACK & IMPROVE
• Smart Goals: Set custom targets for memorization, revision, or reading (e.g., "Surah Al-Kahf every Friday" or "Review Juz 30").
• Advanced Analytics: Visualize your progress with streaks and heatmaps. See which Surahs are strong and which Ayahs need more work.
• Unlimited Listening: Listen to your favorite Qaris to perfect your pronunciation and rhythm. Follow along with the text or listen in the background—completely free.
KEY FEATURES
• Voice Search: "Shazam for Quran"—recite any phrase, and Tarteel will instantly find the specific Ayah and Surah.
• Adaptive Mushaf: Choose between Madani or Indo-Pak scripts, with options to hide Ayah markers for a true test of memory.
• Historical Mistakes: Review a log of your past recitation errors to identify patterns and weak spots in your Hifz.
• Privacy First: Tarteel does not sell your data. We operate with Ihsan, prioritizing user privacy and experience.
TARTEEL PREMIUM
While recitation follow-along, listening, and voice search are free, Tarteel Premium unlocks the full power of AI. Start your FREE TRIAL to access:
• Live Memorization Mistake Detection
• Peeking & Hidden Verses Mode
• Goal Planning & Advanced Analytics
• Historical Mistake Tracking
Join the global community of Muslims using Tarteel. Memorize smarter, stay consistent, and correct your recitation instantly.
—
NOTES:
Tarteel requires microphone access and a stable internet connection in order for its voice features to function properly. Please ensure you allow Tarteel to access these permissions on your device.
Privacy Policy: https://www.tarteel.ai/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://www.tarteel.ai/terms/

bluejetty:00134028:android.description:
Relive history! Play or create your own missions in World War 2 and all the way through the Cold War. Learn to master the skill of the commander and conquer every enemy!
Wargame & Turn-based Simulation
From the Battle of Stalingrad to the Normandy landings, it’s got the vast majority of WW2 covered. Play as the Soviet Union, Republic of China, United States, Great Britain, or any of the near 100 countries with more to come! Attack enemy strongholds and defend your cities with 20+ land, naval, and air units. Even same units have special functionalities depending on the country's faction!
Campaigns & Conquests
There are currently about 30 or so missions and conquest maps. The missions can be played through the story line, and the conquests (you get to choose your country) feature 1939-1943 Europe and 1937-1941 Asia. All the campaign maps can be downloaded and modified at your own will, as seen in the following section...
Sandbox & Custom Maps
Like I said, you can create your own maps... you can even upload them for the world to see! The map editor is readily available for use inside the base game. Every aspect of a mission is customizable: a country’s alliance, resources, cities, airports, troops, veterency, troop attack distance, winning conditions, and even which troops have generals can be customized.
Simulated Politics
From custom events to war declarations, this recent addition allows dynamic games of multiple alliances and betrayals; custom events can also be made to reflect historical events with different types of consequences (changes to resources, alliances, unit experience). Aid can also be given to allies like Lend Lease in the real WW2.
Historical Generals
Hundreds of generals - with more coming by each update - from various countries around the world. Generals are not tied to specific units; they can be sacked from a unit on the spot and be replaced at any time. A general can also command multiple units based on their command size.
About Me
I’m an indie student developer, so this app is very flexible in terms of update content. Please feel free to contact me if you want to make suggestions or collaborate to make the game better.

apple-macos:6817253103.name: Pinto Notes: Notes & Lists
apple-macos:6817253103.description:
Pinto Notes is a simple notes app your AI can use.
It works like the notes app you already know, with folders, checklists, tables and photos. The difference is that ChatGPT and Claude can read and update your notes when you let them.
ASK YOUR AI, IT'S IN YOUR NOTES
• "Add oat milk to my groceries." It's on your phone a second later.
• "What did we decide about the Lisbon hotel?" Your AI reads the note and answers.
• "Turn this meeting into a checklist in Work." Done, on every device.
• Every line an AI changes is highlighted, with Undo next to it.
A NOTES APP FIRST
• Checklists that move ticked items to the bottom
• Headings, bullets, numbered lists and quotes
• Tables you edit cell by cell
• Photos, PDFs and files in your notes and folders
• Sub-notes that keep details one tap away
• Keep writing offline. Changes sync when you're back.
• Lock a note with a password and Face ID
ENCRYPTED
Your notes are encrypted on your iPhone and Mac before they sync. We keep a locked copy of your key, so signing in on a new device opens your notes. It also means we could open them if we had to, for example under a court order. An AI you connect reads the notes it asks for through our server. A note you share as a web page is readable by anyone with the link.
YOU DECIDE WHO GETS IN
• You approve every AI connection
• Disconnect an AI at any time
• Every change keeps the earlier version, so you can go back
• Share a note as a web page and stop sharing whenever you like
• Delete your account and everything in it from Settings
BRING YOUR NOTES
Import from Evernote, Google Keep, or Markdown and text files. On the Mac, import from Apple Notes in one step.
No ads and no tracking. Open source. 2 GB of storage.
Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Connecting ChatGPT or Claude needs your own account with that service.
Pinto Notes was called Amber Notes until October 2026.

apple-macos:946169237.name: Achilleus 3D Tactical Map
apple-macos:946169237.description:
Achilleus 3D Tactical Map turns your iPhone and iPad into a complete field mapping system: real 3D terrain, every common grid, drone control, patrols and video, an AR view, offline maps and a team network encrypted end to end, with no external server needed.
Built for soldiers and reservists, security teams, first responders, search and rescue, drone pilots and outdoor professionals.
DRONE CONTROL (GROUND STATION)
• Fly ArduPilot and PX4 multirotors from your map over Wi-Fi or a network: take off, Pause, Return, Land, Fly here, Orbit, Point the camera
• Missions with heights above the ground: waypoints, surveys, corridors, orbits and search patterns, checked for terrain, radio range and battery
• Listen-only by default, every move confirmed with a slide, MAVLink 2 signing, geofence
• Practice drones to train; QGroundControl and Mission Planner files; flight logs
DRONE PATROL
• Guard a site with several drones: draw the area or pick one of your shapes; along the edge, the whole area or watch points, each drone on its own part
• Alerts for people and vehicles with a snapshot, time and coordinates; the nearest drone goes to look
• Battery changes planned: a drone low on battery is relieved and its part covered
• Detections list with Go to and CSV; alerts to your team and TAK only if you choose
FLY WITHOUT GPS (DIGITAL INS)
• GPS jammed? The app keeps flying your ArduPilot or PX4 drone on an inertial estimate learned from how it leans and flies, with an honest circle of where it is
• Catches a spoofed GPS that jumps or lies, and tells the drone to drop it
• Fix it by tapping a landmark, or let map match find the camera's view on the satellite map
• Link lost too: a helper on the drone flies it home (ArduPilot). After landing, its own log gives the exact track
LIVE VIDEO FROM DRONES & CAMERAS
• Drones, ground stations and IP cameras beside the map (RTSP, UDP, HLS), placed from STANAG 4609 (KLV) or MAVLink with the camera's footprint
• Tap the video to mark that spot; detect and follow people and vehicles; your markers in the drone's picture
• ONVIF pan, tilt and zoom; recording with map data and replay
AR VIEW (AUGMENTED REALITY)
• Hold up your phone: markers, teammates, TAK users, drones and drawings in their real places in the camera picture, with distance and height
• North fine-tuned offline on a landmark or the skyline; 2× zoom; mark a point under the cross
3D TERRAIN & OFFLINE MAPS
• Real terrain in 3D; satellite, topographic and street maps, or your own XYZ, WMTS and WMS sources
• Download areas and keep working without signal; red night mode
COORDINATES & GRIDS
• MGRS, UTM, Lat/Lon, British and Indian grids, in WGS 84, ED50 and other datums
• Convert one point or a whole list; Go to any position
MEASURE & ANALYSE
• Distance and bearing in mils or degrees; elevation profiles and slope
• Line of sight and viewshed; the highest and lowest points of an area; KMZ export
MARKERS, DRAWINGS & TACTICAL GRAPHICS
• MIL-STD-2525D symbols, flags or your own icons, with photos, range rings and layers
• Lines, routes and areas; operation plans with task graphics; KML, KMZ and GPX
NAVIGATE & RECORD
• Walk or drive to any point; record GPS tracks and share your location
ENCRYPTED TEAM NETWORK & TAK
• Wi-Fi, LAN or internet, through a server any device runs or in Mesh mode with no server; encrypted end to end (AES-256) with a team password
• Chat, voice messages and spoken team orders
• ATAK, WinTAK and iTAK users on your map and you on theirs, GeoChat
MADE FOR THE FIELD
• Portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad, adjustable interface size
• No account needed: your data stays on your device
Achilleus is a planning and navigation aid. Always confirm critical positions with official maps and procedures, and follow your local drone rules.
Questions or ideas? Use Settings › Contact — we read every message.
